1950.title: Arms & Abs: Strength & Stability
1950.theWhy: An energizing arm and core workout designed with your strength in mind. We're zeroing in on the biceps, triceps, and deep core muscles — boosting stability, improving balance, and supporting better posture along the way. These low-impact, muscle-focused moves help you stay strong through every phase of menopause. Grab your weights and lets get to work together.

1957.title: Upper Body Blast
1957.theWhy: Welcome strong friend. Today is all about upper body strength-shoulders, arms, back, and a little core fire to keep things balanced. We're here to build muscle, support better posture, and remind your body what it's capable of. You don't have to go hard-you just have to show up. Let's get into it.

1960.title: Lift and Strengthen
1960.theWhy: Today's workout is all about building a strong, stable lower body-because your legs and glutes aren't just for show. They support your hips, knees, and spine, and help you do everyday things like climbing stairs, getting up from the couch, or catching yourself when you trip. During menopause, hormonal shifts can lead to muscle loss and balance issues, making lower body strength even more important. Today we target the muscles that keep you steady, supported, and moving with confidence. Let's build the kind of strength that carries you through life.

1962.title: Full Body Fusion
1962.theWhy: A heart-pumping, muscle-waking workout that blends strength and cardio for maximum impact in minimal time. This session challenges your entire body with powerful compound moves that build muscle endurance, coordination, and strength-all essential elements for women navigating the shifts of menopause. It's easy to lose stamina and muscle as we age, but training like this helps by building lean muscle, keeping joints supported, and elevating our mood. Finish today feeling invigorated and accomplished.

1963.title: Homegrown Strength

equipment.itemSubtext: or couch to hook feet, optional

1963.theWhy: Your core is more than just your abs-it's your body's center of gravity, your support system, and your power source. So, strengthening the core (and lower back) is essential. As hormone levels shift, we may experience decreased bone density, increased risk of osteoporosis, joint stiffness, and changes in body composition.\u000A\u000AA strong core helps counterbalance those changes by improving posture, reducing back pain, and enhancing balance and stability to help prevent falls. Engaging in core and lower back exercises can enhance overall physical health, boost confidence, and improve quality of life during and after menopause.
1963.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1 — rest 15 seconds between each move\u000A\u000ASlow Sit Up — 30 seconds x 3\u000A\u000AGlute Bridge — 30 seconds x 3\u000A\u000AFlutter Kicks — 30 seconds\u000AIn & Outs — 30 seconds\u000ALeg Lifts — 30 seconds\u000A\u000AOblique Crunch — 30 seconds right\u000AOblique Crunch — 15 seconds right/left\u000AOblique Crunch — 30 seconds\u000A\u000ABird Dog — 30 seconds right\u000ABird Dog — 30 seconds left\u000ABird Dog — 30 seconds alternating\u000A\u000ASuperman — 30 seconds alternating\u000ASuperman — 30 seconds both sides together\u000A\u000AReverse Leg Raises — 30 seconds alternating x 3

1964.title: Leveled Up Legs
1964.theWhy: Menopausal women greatly benefit from targeted glute, hamstring, and calf work for several reasons. Hormonal changes during menopause can lead to decreased muscle mass, making it essential to strengthen these areas to maintain overall function and stability. Strong glutes and hamstrings support proper posture and balance, helping to prevent falls and injuries. Additionally, building muscle in the lower body can boost metabolism, manage weight gain, and improve mobility for daily activities. Weight-bearing exercises also enhance bone density, reducing the risk of osteoporosis. Overall, focusing on these muscle groups promotes physical health, boosts confidence, and improves quality of life during menopause.
1964.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1 — rest 15 seconds between each move\u000A\u000AStiff Leg Deadlifts — 45 seconds\u000A\u000A3-2-1 Squat Pulse — 45 seconds\u000A\u000ASquat with Calf Raise — 45 seconds\u000A\u000ACalf Jumps — 45 seconds (15 sec neutral, 15 sec pigeon toe, 15 sec foot out)\u000A\u000AWeighted Lunge Glute Lift — 45 seconds right/left\u000A\u000AHamstring Curls — 45 seconds\u000AStraight Leg Kickback — 45 seconds left\u000A\u000AHamstring Curls — 45 seconds\u000AStraight Leg Kickback — 45 seconds right

1965.title: Push Day Power
1965.theWhy: Focusing on the "push" muscles-chest, shoulders, and triceps-helps build strength, protect joints, and support posture. Women naturally lose muscle mass and bone density, especially in the upper body as estrogen levels decline. These moves help maintain strength where it matters most-so you can lift, carry, and reach with confidence. Plus, strengthening push muscles balance out your pull days and help with injury prevention and muscle imbalances. Let's build strength that sticks.
1965.circuitsCopy: Each exercise 45 seconds with 15 second Rest\u000A\u000ACircuit 1\u000A2 Rounds\u000ASeated Dumbbell Shoulder Press\u000AFront to Side Raise\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A2 Rounds\u000AChest Press\u000ATricep Kickback — switch sides about halfway\u000A\u000ACircuit 3\u000A2 Rounds\u000AKnee Push Ups\u000ATricep Dips\u000A\u000ACircuit 4\u000A2 Rounds\u000APlank Shoulder Taps

1978.title: Basics of Core Activation
1978.theWhy: Let’s start with the basics—rebuilding awareness of your body in space. As we move through midlife, hormonal shifts, years of compensation patterns, and even posture changes can disrupt our connection to core and pelvic floor function. That’s why we begin here. These movements may seem simple, but they’re foundational—and incredibly powerful.\u000A\u000ATake your time. Pause the video when needed. Practicing this breath work daily can make a profound difference. In fact, it may be the single most important skill I teach you throughout this program. This is your starting point for restoring strength, control, and confidence from the inside out.
1978.circuitsCopy: (no reps…free flow “practice”)\u000A—Learn to Inhale\u000A—Learn to Engage\u000A—Pelvic Tilt\u000A—Bridge

1980.title: Linking the Core, Inner Thigh and Glutes
1980.theWhy: Your pelvic floor doesn’t work in isolation—it’s closely connected to your inner thighs and glutes. These muscle groups form part of a supportive system that stabilizes your pelvis and helps you move efficiently and safely. When one group is out of sync, the whole system can be affected.\u000A\u000AProper breath timing is key to activating the pelvic floor effectively. It might seem simple, but pressing into the ball is important work. That gentle resistance provides sensory feedback to help your brain better connect with your deep core muscles. As we add layers to the movement—breath, pressure, muscle engagement—we’re rebuilding those essential neuromuscular pathways.\u000A\u000AReminder: as you press into the ball, avoid bearing down. Instead, think about lifting through your pelvic floor and gently engaging your core. This kind of coordination is foundational for strength, support, and long-term function.
1980.circuitsCopy: 2 rounds\u000A\u000A3-position leaning band abduction\u000ABridge with Ball Squeeze\u000ALeaning Ball Squeezes

2039.title: Powerhouse Legs
2039.theWhy: Maintaining leg and glute strength is essential for improving balance, posture, and mobility. Muscle mass can decrease as we age, and engaging in strength training like this, you can combat muscle loss, support bone density, and boost metabolism. Not only will this workout help keep you strong on your feet, but it also helps improve daily movement, making everyday tasks feel easier.

2040.title: Upper Body Pull Power
2040.theWhy: Today's Pull Day workout is all about strengthening your back and biceps, two areas that deserve some extra TLC. These exercises help you stand tall with improved posture and make those everyday tasks like lifting grocery bags or carrying heavy bags of mulch or dog food feel effortless. Not only will your back and biceps thank you, but your confidence will get a serious boost too. Let's dive in and strengthen those muscles that keep you moving and feeling powerful every day!

2041.title: Core Confidence
2041.theWhy: This 20-minute standing ab workout is designed to strengthen your core while improving posture, stability, and balance. By focusing on the muscles in your midsection, you'll feel more confident in your movements, whether you're standing tall, sitting, or moving throughout your day. Plus, this is low-impact, which is easier on the joints, allowing you to get the full benefits without the strain. Strengthening your core can also boost your confidence and help you maintain an active lifestyle, keeping you strong, stable, and feeling your best.

2042.title: Firm & Fabulous
2042.theWhy: This total body kettlebell workout is a powerhouse for building strength, improving endurance, and boosting cardiovascular health—all in one dynamic session. It targets multiple muscle groups at once, which not only enhances your overall fitness but also improves core stability, flexibility, and mobility. The combination of functional movements helps improve balance and coordination, making everyday tasks feel easier and more effortless. Plus, it's quick and efficient—ideal for a busy schedule while still delivering maximum results. Whether you're looking to increase strength, improve flexibility, or challenge your body in new ways, this workout is your go-to for feeling empowered and strong!

2044.title: Upper Body Uprising
2044.theWhy: This chest, shoulder, and tricep workout is designed to maintain and build essential muscle strength. As you strengthen these areas, you'll support your bone health, boost your metabolism, and improve your mood. Plus, working on your upper body strength improves posture, making you feel more confident and less fatigued during everyday tasks. Whether you're lifting groceries or reaching for the top shelf, this workout helps ensure you're ready for anything—while promoting overall well-being during menopause.

2045.title: Feeling the Burn
2045.theWhy: Today we focus on functional movements that strengthen the muscles you rely on every day—your legs and core. It's all about building strength, helping you move with more confidence and ease. These exercises improve your ability to perform everyday tasks like bending, lifting, and walking, while enhancing your stability, flexibility, and mobility. You’ll feel empowered, energized, and ready to take on whatever comes your way.
2045.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1 — Each exercise 45 seconds x2 with 15 second Rest\u000A\u000AGoblet Squat\u000AStiff Leg Deadlifts\u000ANarrow to Wide Squat — alternating\u000AAlternating Weighted Rear Lunge\u000AWide Legged Squat\u000AWeighted Crunch\u000AFrog Leg Reverse Crunch

2046.title: Flex Your Power
2046.theWhy: Focusing on your upper back helps counteract that all-too-common rounded-shoulder slump, improving your posture and reducing tension. Strong arms make everyday tasks like carrying groceries or lifting a suitcase feel easier and more controlled. And by engaging your core and pelvic floor muscles together, you support your spine, improve balance, and help prevent those pesky aches and discomforts that tend to sneak in with age.\u000A\u000AThis workout targets multiple muscles at once, maximizing your effort without overwhelming your body. Consistent strength training like this not only builds muscle but also boosts metabolism, helps maintain healthy bones, and enhances overall mobility — all essential for feeling confident and capable through midlife and beyond.\u000A\u000ATake your time with each movement, focusing on form and control. Remember, strength isn’t about rushing through reps — it’s about building resilience and honoring your body’s unique needs.

2047.title: Menopause Mayhem
2047.theWhy: Today, we’re focusing on building a strong foundation by targeting the core and glutes. These two muscle groups play a key role in maintaining stability, improving posture, and reducing discomfort. Strengthening them not only enhances your daily movements but also boosts your overall functional fitness, so you feel more supported and confident in everything you do.

2048.title: Full Body Strength Builder
2048.theWhy: Compound movements are an efficient way to build strength, improve coordination, and enhance endurance. By engaging more than one muscle group at a time, we maximize the benefits of each move, allowing you to work smarter, not harder. This approach helps you stay engaged and challenged throughout the workout, while also improving your overall functional fitness for daily life.\u000A\u000AToday's full body approach is all about maximizing efficiency, giving you a comprehensive workout in less time.
2048.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1 — Each exercise 45 seconds x2 with 15 second Rest\u000A\u000AGoblet Squat — Deadlift Combo\u000AWide Squat — Upright Row Combo\u000ANarrow Squat — Front Raise Combo\u000AReverse Lunge with Bicep Curl — alternating\u000A1-Arm Bent Over Row — Tricep Extension Combo — right/left\u000APush Up — Superman Combo\u000ABoat with Alternating Shoulder Press

2055.title: Crossbody Connection & Finding Your Low Abs
2055.theWhy: Your core isn’t just a front-and-center muscle group—it’s a dynamic system that works diagonally, from shoulder to opposite hip, glute to opposite side abdominals. This is called crossbody connection, and it plays a major role in how we move, stabilize, and support our spine and pelvis.\u000A\u000AAs we age—or simply go through seasons of stress, injury, or hormonal shifts—we can lose touch with these deeper, stabilizing muscles, especially the lower abdominals. This area is often underactive and tricky to find, but it’s crucial for pelvic floor support, balance, and core control.\u000A\u000AThese exercises are designed to reestablish that connection. By moving in patterns that cross the midline of your body, we’re waking up those deep core muscles and strengthening the communication between your brain and body. Don’t rush it. Slower, more intentional movement leads to better activation and lasting strength.
2055.circuitsCopy: 2 rounds\u000A\u000ABird Dog Options\u000AHeel Tap with Crossbody Ball Push\u000ABall Push Side Lying Leg Lift\u000ASide Bridge with Ball Squeeze

2056.title: Learning “Ribs Down” Overhead
2056.theWhy: Reaching overhead seems like it should be easy, right? But here’s the thing—when your ribs pop up like they’re trying to say hello to your bra, your core checks out and your spine pays the price. That’s why we focus on keeping the “ribs down” and your deep core turned on.\u000A\u000AYou’ll hear me say, “no rib boobs!”—which is my classy way of reminding you not to let your chest puff up and your ribs go rogue. It’s not about yanking your ribs down like you’re bracing for a punch, but about gently keeping them stacked over your pelvis, supported by breath and muscle control.\u000A\u000AIt might feel awkward at first—like rubbing your belly and patting your head—but this small tweak makes a big difference. Better posture, stronger core, happier pelvic floor. And honestly, who doesn’t want to look fabulous reaching for the top shelf?

2057.title: Extended Core Bracing
2057.theWhy: This is where your core learns to show up—and stay up—for the whole shebang. Not just in those slow, controlled breaths on the mat, but when you're doing real-life things like reaching for the top shelf, lunging to grab your runaway dog, or wrangling a heavy grocery bag.\u000A\u000AIt’s not about clenching everything or sucking in. It's about staying connected to your deep core and pelvic floor while your body does what it needs to do. It’s about using your breath to stay connected so you can move with control and confidence. Think of it like multitasking: move, breathe, and support yourself all at once. It’s one of the most practical skills you’ll ever learn—and a total game-changer for feeling strong and steady in daily life.

2115.title: Core and Glute Fusion
2115.theWhy: Not your typical booty band workout! Resistance training is a must and today's class pairs weights with a mini resistance band loop to bring you some serious glute strength and another level of core stability work required. We’re sneaking in some biceps and triceps as well, look for it during our spine mobility sequence.

2118.title: Hip Hip Hooray
2118.theWhy: Hip strength and core stability go hand in hand to improve balance, which is what today's class is all about. \u000A\u000AThe Pilates ball is a perfect prop to work on balance at any age. If you feel a little wobbly during the side lying leg circles, slow down and connect to your breath.

2119.title: Mat's All Folks
2119.theWhy: This is a total body workout designed to leave you feeling strong, lengthened and smiling. You'll flow through glute-building, deep core activating and shoulder-strengthening moves—all on the mat. This class promises a fun, challenging session leaving you feeling energized!

2120.title: Hips & Dips
2120.theWhy: This flow focuses on improving spine mobility, shoulder stability, and alignment while strengthening your hips, core, and upper body. \u000A\u000AWhether you’re shaking off stiffness or just looking to move with ease, this class will have you feeling free and fabulous in no time!

2121.title: Grind and Shine
2121.theWhy: This dynamic hip strengthening flow works around the whole hip complex. Starting from the glutes in the back and working all the way around to the front of the hips and ending with core, you’ll work on strength & control for those sneaky muscles you didn’t know you had. This class will leave your hips feeling happy & strong.

2122.title: Back in Action
2122.theWhy: This spine and hamstring-focused Pilates flow is a favorite to reconnect you to the back of your body and realign posture. Through gentle spine mobility, deep core activation, and sneaky Pilates ball instability, you’ll improve strength in your hamstrings while giving your spine the love it deserves. Perfect for anyone looking to release tension, improve posture, and feel like they’ve hit the reset button.

2123.title: Total Body Chair Fusion
2123.theWhy: This total body chair class brings the best of Pilates to a whole new level, combining strength, balance, and flexibility for a dynamic full-body workout. From challenging core moves to inner thigh magic, every exercise will challenge you in ways that leave you feeling stronger and more centered.

2124.title: Booty-ful Burn
2124.theWhy: A ‘booty band burn’ like no other. Building glutes are a foundation for every body, especially in menopause! This class pairs glutes with dynamic upper body strength, challenging balance and core stability — leaving you feeling energized, empowered and strong.

2125.title: Peach Perfect
2125.theWhy: An uplifting, dynamic class to target glutes and work on hip extension using the Pilates ball. This class is fun with a sneaky burn! Pro tip: if it is uncomfortable for your wrists to push into the ball while on all 4’s, try pushing down into a block (or something firmer) instead.

2126.title: Legs for Days
2126.theWhy: We’re (literally) sliding into today's workout with a dynamic, lower-body focused flow that will leave your legs stronger, hips feeling open, and like your whole body has grown another inch or two! Socks to slide on a wood or tile floor work well or grab a paper/ plastic plate if you’re working out on a carpeted surface.

2127.title: Banded Flow
2127.theWhy: Today's class we get creative with using a long resistance loop and finding new and creative ways to add resistance to some Pilates exercise favorites. This total body flow is a mix of fun & strength training. We’ll end today with a classic Pilates move with some feel-good spine mobility and a delicious calf stretch.

2128.title: Plank You Very Much
2128.theWhy: Bodyweight classes offer a fun, do it anywhere vibe, and this class has it all! This dynamic, full body strength class is full of sneaky challenges within a dynamic flow. You’ll feel stronger, taller and have more energy at the end of this class.

2129.title: Dynamic Duo: Glutes + Core
2129.theWhy: Today is a power packed class featuring the dynamic duo of glutes and core. We’re mixing traditional strength training with Pilates favorites and upping the ante by using the small resistance loop. If the band feels too heavy or you’re losing form, you can always go to no band or to a lighter resistance band and work up to a medium or heavier weight.

2130.title: Spine of Your Life
2130.theWhy: Today’s class focuses on spine health, strength and mobility in a full body workout. We start out standing and make our way down to the mat, finishing with a dynamic upper body and core flow.\u000A\u000APro Tip: If it feels uncomfortable to lay on your belly or you feel your lower back doing most of the work, try propping a small pillow or towel under your hips bones to tip your pubic bone towards the ground and lengthen your lower back.

2131.title: The Ball & The Beautiful
2131.theWhy: This class pairs grace with strength, while using the Pilates ball to improve your spine mobility and challenge your core stability. Hips, glutes and core strength are also a fantastic way to help improve your pelvic floor health!

2132.title: Core Values
2132.theWhy: Core Values is a total body sculpt class that incorporates light weights and body weight for a dynamic and spicy flow. We work on weight bearing for hands and wrists, as these are an important piece to maintaining grip strength, shoulder stability and everyday small motor function in our fingers as we age. It can be a challenge, so take small breaks as you need and look for the ‘thumb + finger flicks’ during class to help release wrist tension.

2133.title: Arm-azing Sculpt
2133.theWhy: Upper body strength, spine mobility, and deep core engagement are being served in this class. Keep the weights light (between 2-5 lbs) to start as those shoulder exercises can be sneaky hard! And as Joseph Pilates said: ‘You’re only as young as your spine’.

2134.title: Full Body Chair Flow
2134.theWhy: This fun, full body flow takes Pilates mat and reformer exercises and moves them onto (and around) a chair for a total body strength class. Using a chair with a back on it can be helpful over a bench, as you’ll want to hold the back of the chair for balance.

2144.title: Core Engagement & Breath Work
2144.theWhy: This Pilates class focuses on strengthening your core muscles while enhancing breath control and awareness. Through targeted exercises, you’ll improve spinal stability, posture, and overall body alignment.

2150.title: Flexibility & Strength
2150.theWhy: You’re only as young as you are flexible! Pilates is a combination of flexibility and strength-as we age we need both!

2153.title: Strength & Posture
2153.theWhy: To find good posture-which is everything when we work out and in our general life.

2156.title: Core & Lower Body
2156.theWhy: This Pilates class focuses on building core and lower body strength to support hormonal changes and overall well-being. Gentle, low-impact movements help tone the abs, hips, glutes, and legs while improving balance, bone health, and joint mobility.

2164.title: Balance & Stability
2164.theWhy: Build a strong foundation from the ground up in this Pilates class focused on improving balance, core stability, and overall body control. Using slow, intentional movements, you’ll strengthen the muscles that support posture, coordination, and joint health.

2218.title: Core, Stretch, & Mobility
2218.theWhy: Through gentle, purposeful stretching and controlled exercises, this class will help you release tension, enhance range of motion, and support better posture and alignment. Suitable for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to move more freely, recover from tightness, or incorporate restorative movement into their routine.

2219.title: Full Body Strength
2219.theWhy: This workout combines strengthening and flexibility while adding relaxation techniques. Today we strengthen and find connection and concentration which helps manage stress!

2220.title: Pilates Strong
2220.theWhy: Challenge your strength and stamina in this dynamic, bodyweight-only Pilates class. Designed to build lean muscle and enhance core stability, you'll move through powerful sequences that target the entire body—no equipment needed. Expect precise, controlled movements that improve endurance, posture, and total-body strength.

2221.title: Pilates Length & Resistance
2221.theWhy: Now that the foundation is built, focus on strengthening the core and glutes more intensely. These exercises also engage the whole body to improve endurance.

2222.title: Pilates Core, Length & Strength
2222.theWhy: Today we blend deep core activation with dynamic strength-building and lengthening exercises to create a balanced, full-body workout. You'll tone and strengthen key muscle groups while improving flexibility, posture, and body alignment. With a focus on controlled movement and breath, this class helps you feel both strong and spacious—energized yet grounded.

2223.title: Back & Hips
2223.theWhy: This Pilates class focuses on strengthening and mobilizing the muscles supporting your spine and hips to release tension and promote relaxation. Gentle, mindful movements combined with breath work help reduce stress and manage cortisol levels, supporting overall well-being.

2224.title: Restorative Mobility
2224.theWhy: This gentle Pilates class is designed to promote deep relaxation, release cortisol, and celebrate the strength and support of your pelvic floor. Through slow, mindful movements and breath work, you’ll enhance joint mobility, reduce tension, and reconnect with your body’s natural rhythm.

2225.title: Full Body Flow
2225.theWhy: This class will focus on combining the strength, balance, and flexibility work from previous sessions into full-body movements. We will put things together and get comfortable with transitions and keeping things flowing.

2226.title: Pilates Sculpt
2226.theWhy: Elevate your Pilates practice with this energizing class that combines traditional Pilates movements with light weights to tone and sculpt your entire body. Focused on building lean muscle, improving endurance, and enhancing core strength, this class challenges your stability and control while adding resistance for a deeper workout.

2227.title: Pilates Strength & Length
2227.theWhy: This Pilates class combines core-focused strength exercises with lengthening movements to help you build a strong, supported body. Using resistance bands, you'll engage and tone muscles throughout your entire body while improving flexibility and posture. With mindful breathing and controlled movement, this class empowers you to feel stronger, more balanced, and confident in every exercise and daily activity.

2228.title: Pilates with Ball: Tuning In
2228.theWhy: These final workouts in this program focus on recovery, mindfulness, and gentle stretching. We will continue to work smarter, not harder to find that deep core engagement.

2229.title: Full Body Scuplt
2229.theWhy: This session brings together core engagement, mindful movement, and full-body sculpting using bodyweight and optional light dumbbells.

2230.title: Gentle Flow & Reflection
2230.theWhy: Celebrate your strength and progress in this empowering, full-body Pilates workout. This class brings together everything you've built—core stability, lean muscle, and mindful movement—into one energizing session.

2231.title: Energizing Morning Practice
2231.theWhy: This session is designed to gently wake up the body, clear the mind, and set a positive, focused tone for the day ahead. We'll move through a series of mindful poses that boost circulation, build strength, and invite fresh energy in—perfect for shaking off any lingering sleepiness and stepping into the day feeling grounded, open, and refreshed. Listen to your body, breathe deeply, and enjoy this time for yourself.
2231.circuitsCopy: Warm up\u000ASeated Breath of Joy\u000ASide Stretch\u000ACat-Cow\u000ADownward Facing Dog\u000A\u000AMain Flow\u000ASun Salutation A\u000ATree Pose\u000A\u000AClosing\u000ASeated Twist\u000ASeated Forward Fold

2232.title: Winding Down
2232.theWhy: This is a gentle, grounding practice designed to help you slow down, release tension, and transition into a more restful state. This class is all about softening—both in the body and the mind. Through mindful movement, breathwork, and longer-held poses, we’ll ease out of the day’s busyness and into a place of calm and clarity. Let this be your time to exhale fully, reconnect, and restore. There’s no need to strive—just arrive, breathe, and be.
2232.circuitsCopy: Seated grounding\u000A\u000AWarn up\u000ANeck stretches\u000ACat-Cow\u000AChild’s pose\u000A\u000AMain Flow\u000ASeated forward fold\u000AButterfly\u000AReclined spinal twist\u000ALegs up the wall\u000A\u000AClosing\u000AAlternate nostril breathing

2233.title: Gratitude
2233.theWhy: This is a gentle practice centered on gratitude—for our bodies, our breath, and this moment. As we move, breathe, and rest, let’s open to the simple gifts around and within us. No pressure, just presence.
2233.circuitsCopy: Seated gratitude meditation\u000A\u000AWarm up\u000ASeated cat-cow\u000AHeart opening side stretch\u000Athread-the-needle\u000A\u000AMain flow\u000AMelting heart\u000ALow lunge\u000ABridge\u000ASeated forward fold\u000AReclined heart opener\u000A\u000AClosing\u000AGratitude savasana

2234.title: Mobility & Arthritis
2234.theWhy: Today’s practice is designed to gently support healthy movement, improve flexibility, and keep the joints feeling strong and supported. We’ll move at a comfortable pace, with options for all levels, focusing on ease, balance, and body awareness. This is about staying active, feeling good, and enjoying the way your body moves—one breath at a time.
2234.circuitsCopy: Grounding/breath\u000A\u000AGentle neck rolls\u000A\u000AWarm up\u000AWrist and finger\u000AShoulder rolls\u000AAnkle and toes\u000A\u000AMain flow\u000ACat-cow\u000ASide stretch\u000AKnee and hip — seated marching\u000ALow lunge — hip\u000A\u000AClosing\u000ASeated twist\u000ASavasana — release tension

2235.title: Boosting Circulation
2235.theWhy: This Boosting Circulation practice is designed with the menopausal body in mind—supporting healthy blood flow, easing tension, and helping regulate temperature and energy. We’ll move gently but purposefully, encouraging circulation to reduce stiffness, calm the nervous system, and bring a sense of balance and vitality. Listen to what your body needs today, and know that this time is for you. Let’s begin, with steady breath and self-kindness.
2235.circuitsCopy: Seated breath with gentle arm movement\u000A\u000AAnkle and wrist rotation\u000A\u000AWarm up\u000ADynamic seated twist\u000AStanding arm swing\u000AWall push-offs\u000A\u000AMain flow\u000ACat-cow\u000AStanding forward fold/grab arms swing side to side\u000ALow lunge — ½ splits\u000ALegs-up-wall\u000A\u000AClosing\u000ASeated forward fold with pulsing\u000AFinal relaxation and visualization

2236.title: Embracing Change
2236.theWhy: Today’s practice is a gentle reminder that change is a natural, necessary part of life, even when it feels uncertain or uncomfortable. Through movement, breath, and stillness, we’ll explore how to stay grounded and open in times of transition—whether it’s in the body, the mind, or in life itself. Let this be a space to release resistance, invite trust, and connect to your own resilience. You are allowed to move through change with grace, at your own pace.
2236.circuitsCopy: Grounding/intention setting: “I am resilient, I welcome change with grace and ease”\u000A\u000AWarm up\u000ASeated cat-cow\u000ASeated side stretch\u000ASeated twist\u000A\u000AMain flow\u000AChilds pose\u000ATable top/thread the needle\u000ALow lunge with heart opener\u000AWide-legged forward flow\u000AReclined bound angle pose\u000A\u000AClosing\u000ASupported reclined twist\u000ASavasava with affirmation “I embrace change with courage and trust"

2237.title: Twists for Detox & Renewal
2237.theWhy: Today’s class is all about wringing out the old and making space for the new—physically, mentally, and emotionally. Twisting poses help stimulate digestion, support the body’s natural detox process, and create a sense of clarity and renewal from the inside out. We’ll move mindfully, breathe deeply, and invite a fresh, revitalized energy into the body. Let go of what you no longer need—and feel yourself come back into balance.

2238.title: Flexibility & Freedom
2238.theWhy: Today’s practice is all about Flexibility and Freedom—inviting ease in the body and openness in the mind. Through gentle stretches and mindful movement, we’ll work to release tightness, improve range of motion, and create space to move freely—both on and off the mat. This practice encourages you to let go of limitations and embrace the joy of movement, wherever you are today.
2238.circuitsCopy: Grounding breaths\u000A\u000ANeck rolls\u000A\u000AWarm up\u000ACat-cow\u000AThread the needle\u000A\u000AMain flow\u000ALateral stretch — side\u000APyramid pose\u000ASeated forward fold right, left, center\u000AReclined hand to big toe\u000A\u000AClosing\u000AWindshield wipers\u000ASavasana

2239.title: Breath & Movement
2239.theWhy: Today’s practice focuses on the beautiful connection between breath and movement. We’ll explore how mindful breathing can guide and deepen each movement, helping you find flow, balance, and presence in your body. Let your breath be your anchor as we move with intention and ease.
2239.circuitsCopy: Seated breath\u000A\u000ASeated cat-cow\u000A\u000AWarm up\u000ATable — elbow to knee\u000AChild’s pose to cobra\u000A\u000AMain flow\u000ASun salutation\u000AWarrior flow II — reverse\u000ACat-cow table\u000A\u000AClosing\u000ASeated forward with breath focus\u000ASavasana

2240.title: Shoulders & Neck
2240.theWhy: This practice focuses on gently releasing tension in the shoulders and neck—areas that can often feel tight or uncomfortable during menopause due to stress, hormone changes, or restless nights. We’ll use slow, mindful movements and breath to ease stiffness, calm the nervous system, and bring soothing relief. This is your time to nurture yourself and listen deeply to what your body needs. Let’s begin with kindness and care.
2240.circuitsCopy: Seated centering\u000A\u000AGentle neck\u000A\u000AShoulder stretch\u000A\u000AWarm up\u000ATable/dog-bird\u000AThread the needle\u000A\u000AMain flow\u000AEagle arms\u000ARow face arms\u000AStanding/clasped hands behind back\u000ASupported fish\u000A\u000AClosing\u000AShoulder and neck stretch\u000ASavasana

2241.title: Your Groove Thing
2241.theWhy: Be patient with yourself during this free flow. Enjoy the freedom of movement in your body.

2242.title: Pelvic Floor Awareness
2242.theWhy: Today we’ll begin by gently tuning into these muscles through breath and subtle engagement, learning how to activate and release them with intention. You’ll be guided through exercises that build strength and flexibility, helping improve stability, bladder support, and overall comfort. Move at your own pace, listen closely to your body, and use this time to cultivate connection and control.
2242.circuitsCopy: Grounding Breathing\u000A\u000APelvic Tilts\u000A\u000AWarm Up\u000ACat-Cow\u000ABridge Pose\u000A\u000AMain Flow\u000AButterfly\u000AHappy Baby\u000AChild’s Pose\u000ASeated Root Lock\u000A\u000AClosing\u000AReclined Relaxation\u000AGentle Reclined Twist

2243.title: Core Awakening
2243.theWhy: Today’s practice focuses on gently connecting with and strengthening the muscles that support your spine, pelvis, and overall balance. We’ll move slowly and mindfully, using breath and subtle engagement to activate your deep core muscles safely and effectively. This practice is designed to help improve stability, posture, and ease in everyday movement—at a comfortable pace that honors where you are today.
2243.circuitsCopy: Grounding breath\u000A\u000ASeated spinal circles\u000A\u000AWarm up\u000ACat-cow\u000ABird-dog\u000A\u000AMain flow\u000ADownward dog knee to chest\u000ALow lunge\u000ABoat pose\u000APlank\u000A\u000AClosing\u000AWindshield\u000ASavasana

2244.title: Balance & Stability
2244.theWhy: Today’s practice centers on Balance and Stability, which become especially important during menopause as hormonal shifts can impact muscle strength, joint health, and coordination. We’ll focus on engaging the core and lower body muscles to improve posture, prevent falls, and support your overall mobility. By moving mindfully and integrating breath awareness, you’ll help your body stay steady and responsive to daily movements. Balance is a skill that grows stronger with consistent practice, so listen to your body and move at a pace that feels right for you.

2245.title: Hips & Lower Back
2245.theWhy: Today’s practice focuses on the hips and lower back—areas that often hold tension and affect our overall comfort and mobility. We’ll gently release tightness, improve flexibility, and build strength to support these key areas. Move slowly, breathe deeply, and listen to your body as we work toward ease and balance in your hips and lower back.

2246.title: Strength & Confidence
2246.theWhy: Today’s practice is designed to help you build strength and confidence—both physically and emotionally. We’ll focus on movements that empower your body, improve stability, and connect you to your inner resilience. This is your time to honor your unique strength, embrace your power, and move with intention and grace.
2246.circuitsCopy: Seated power breath\u000A\u000ASeated arm circles\u000A\u000AWarm up\u000APlank to downward facing dog\u000ALunge with power arms\u000A\u000AMain flow\u000AWarrior III\u000AReverse warrior\u000AExalted warrior\u000A½ moon\u000A\u000AClosing\u000ABridge\u000ASavasana

2247.title: Grounding & Connection
2247.theWhy: In today’s busy world, there are often many expectations—work, family, social, and even from ourselves—that can create a sense of urgency or anxiety. When we find ourselves caught in that state, our bodies respond by making the heart beat faster and our breath becoming shallow. It can be hard to come back from that feeling of overwhelm. Today’s practice is about Grounding and Connection—bringing ourselves back to center, calming the nervous system, and finding stability within. Through mindful breath and gentle movement, we’ll cultivate a deep sense of rootedness and presence, helping you reconnect to your body and mind with calm and ease.

2248.title: Fly Away
2248.theWhy: Today’s practice is called Fly Away—an invitation to break free from sedentary habits and awaken your body with movement and energy. We’ll focus on opening the body, increasing mobility, and boosting circulation to help you feel lighter, freer, and more alive. This class encourages you to move with intention and joy, shaking off stiffness and inviting more ease into your daily life.
2248.circuitsCopy: Alternate nostril breathing\u000A\u000AShoulder tapping\u000A\u000AWarm up\u000ACat-cow\u000AForward fold\u000A\u000AMain Flow\u000ACobra\u000AHands behind head\u000ASuperman\u000A\u000AClosing\u000APlow\u000ASavasana

2963.title: Exhale to Ease Anxiety
2963.theWhy: This gentle, grounding yoga flow is designed to reduce anxiety, calm the nervous system, and support your body through the transitions of perimenopause and menopause. We’ll begin with a breathing exercise called Nadi Shodhana Pranayama, a powerful technique that balances the nervous system, clears mental fog, and promotes a deep sense of calm. By guiding the breath, we encourage equilibrium between the body and mind, easing stress and restoring inner peace.\u000A\u000AFrom there, we’ll move through a series of restorative postures that gently release tension and invite deep relaxation. Expect to stretch, soften, and surrender before closing with a grounding pose that soothes the body and mind. This practice is your invitation to slow down, breathe deeply, and find ease within.

2964.title: Cooling Moon Flow
2964.theWhy: This flow is designed to cool hot flashes and release heat from the body. We’ll begin with the cooling Sitali or Sitkari Pranayama. Optional hands in Anjali Mudra. Next, we’ll move slowly through three rounds of Chandra Namaskar aka Moon Salutations. Moving fluidly, we’ll access the water qualities in the body, inviting in cooling energy to the body and mind.
2964.circuitsCopy: Pranayama in this practice: Sitali or Sitkari\u000A\u000APoses in this practice:\u000AMoon Salutation

2965.title: The Wind-Down Flow
2965.theWhy: A gentle, soothing practice for the body that can be done before bedtime.
2965.circuitsCopy: Pranayama in this practice: 4 Count Inhale, 8 Count Exhale\u000A\u000APoses in this practice:\u000A— Gentle Side Openers\u000A— Cat/Cow\u000A— Downward Facing Dog\u000A— Forward Fold with Easy Twists\u000A— Supported Squat\u000A— Down Dog\u000A— Pigeon\u000A— Supported Fish\u000A— Bound Angle Up the Wall\u000A— Legs Up Wall\u000A— Savasana

2966.title: Feel to Heal
2966.theWhy: A practice designed to tune in to our hearts and cultivate a mind state of acceptance and self-love.
2966.circuitsCopy: Pranayama in this practice: Humming/bumble bee breath\u000A\u000APoses in this practice:\u000A— Cat Cow\u000A— Rag Doll\u000A— Classical Sun Salutations x 2\u000A— Tree Pose\u000A— Child’s Pose\u000A— Puppy Pose\u000A— Cobra\u000A— Camel\u000A— Half Lord of the Fishes\u000A— Upward Staff\u000A— Cobbler’s Pose\u000A— Cow Face Pose (w/ option to modify on back)\u000A— Happy Baby\u000A— Savasana

2976.title: Hot Flash Arms
2976.theWhy: This fiery workout targets the arms and core with quick, effective moves designed to build strength and stamina. Whether you’re powering through a hot flash or just bringing the heat, this class will leave you feeling strong, confident, and unstoppable.

2977.title: Legs Like Whoa
2977.theWhy: Focuses on toning and strengthening the lower body with a side of core work, leaving you feeling steady, powerful, and ready to tackle anything on your feet.

2978.title: All In One
2978.theWhy: The ultimate full-body workout to lift and strengthen everything at once. Perfect for busy days when you want maximum impact.

2979.title: Abs-olutely Lifted
2979.theWhy: Strengthening the upper body and deep core, this class helps lift and support posture while focusing on moves that energize and uplift—mentally and physically.

2980.title: Glutes that Glow
2980.theWhy: Target your hips, thighs, and glutes with a mix of small isometric movements and larger dynamic exercises. Strengthening these muscles supports your pelvic floor and reduces lower back discomfort.

2981.title: Total Glow Up
2981.theWhy: This full-body session strengthens and sculpts from head to toe while boosting circulation and energy. You’ll leave feeling radiant, strong, and empowered.

2982.title: Core-tastrophe Averted
2982.theWhy: A strong core is essential for stability and injury prevention, especially during perimenopause and menopause. This class targets deep core muscles while keeping it light-hearted and fun.

2983.title: Glutes & Grit
2983.theWhy: This workout emphasizes building strong glutes and a stable core, promoting functional strength for activities like walking, climbing stairs, and maintaining pelvic health.

2984.title: Abso-GLUTE-ly
2984.theWhy: Let’s freaking DO THIS! We are kicking off MAM30 with some serious glutes and hamstring work. This session focuses a little extra on the gluteus medius (the side booty muscle), which helps us with knee, hip and low back health. Go heavy! Remember, it is so important for us to really tax those muscles to get them to GROW! Your last couple reps on each set should feel really spicy!

2985.title: Pumped Up Pecs
2985.theWhy: Today’s main focus is chest and shoulders. Basically, we are pushing things! And push them really good like Salt N’ Peppa told us. In other words, don’t be afraid to find your version of heavy weight on these lifts. We are really working on our core throughout today’s session, and building some stamina through some holds.

3190.title: Spice Up Your Glutes
3190.theWhy: You better believe day 1 is a glute day. Why? Glutes are our powerhouse muscle. They help with posture, stability, power and frankly, they are a metabolic engine. Today we work on bridges and side booty as a great foundation.
3190.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A3 rounds\u000ASquat with Butt Kick — 30 seconds alternating\u000AStanding Abduction — 30 seconds right\u000AStanding Abduction — 30 seconds left\u000ABridge — 30 seconds\u000ABridge Hold — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A3 rounds\u000AWall Sit — 30 seconds\u000AWall Plank Reach — 30 seconds alternating\u000ARest — 15 seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 3\u000A2 rounds\u000AForearm Side Plank — 30 seconds right\u000AForearm Side Plank — 30 seconds left\u000ABridge Hold Heel Lifts — 30 seconds alternating\u000ARest — 30 seconds

3191.title: Ooops, I Lifted Again
3191.theWhy: Push ups are on tap. And in this program we get off the knees and use an elevated surface. This will help you get stronger…quicker, as it teaches total body tension and core activation. I can’t wait to hear how you progress and get better and better at your push ups!
3191.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A4 rounds\u000AElevated Push Ups — 30 seconds\u000ATricep Dips — 30 seconds\u000AElevated Plank with Knee Dips — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000A\u000ARest — 60 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A3 rounds\u000ABand Pull Apart — 30 seconds\u000ATricep Press Down — 30 seconds right\u000ATricep Press Down — 30 seconds left\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 3\u000A1 round\u000ABird Dog Limbs Down — 30 seconds right\u000ABird Dog Limbs Down — 30 seconds left\u000AHeel Taps — 30 seconds

3192.title: Where’s The Fun (WTF)?
3192.theWhy: I’m not going to lie. This one is leg heavy. But strong thighs are literally a predictor of longevity. We are building a strong base and core to support us for life!

3193.title: Resting Squat Face
3193.theWhy: This might be your first time doing a tabata workout. They are challenging intervals, but the beauty of it is…you get to work at YOUR own pace. So push yourself, but pace yourself. I walk you through it each step of the way.
3193.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000ATabata 1 — Sumo Squat to Tap\u000ATabata 2 — Speed Skater\u000ATabata 3 — Knee Drives\u000A\u000ARest — 60 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A3 rounds\u000AHip Thrust — 30 seconds\u000AHip Thrust Hold — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds

3282.title: Booty Duty
3282.theWhy: Welcome to MAM Elite. We have one goal. Get stronger. We are starting with lower body work, with a special focus on the glutes. Glutes are our muscle powerhouse. They help with posture, pelvic health and overall athleticism. You’ll notice real quick that we don’t skip glute days around here! Now let's kick some arse!

3283.title: Your Chestie Bestie
3283.theWhy: Upper body strength!! Today we push. Building a strong chest helps keep the girls up where we want them, and it is such an important function of everyday life…pushing a shopping cart, pushing your partner’s buttons. Let’s push it real good today!

3284.title: Thick Thighs Do Save Lives
3284.theWhy: Okay, this is a true mix of glutes and quads. A lot of women are like, “But I don’t want to grow my quads…just my glutes.” But leg strength is literally a measure of longevity and we don’t eff around. Remember to go heavy on that strength circuit. This is where we build muscle. Take note of your weights so we can compare later!

3301.title: Chased By a Bear
3301.theWhy: Cardio dayyyy. I know this isn’t a fave, but it builds some serious strength, stamina and it keeps us young. You pick your sprint mechanism. Go hard. Leave nothing out there. Tell yourself…it is only 20 seconds!

3302.title: Back-tivate!
3302.theWhy: Back muscles make for some stellar posture. We are kicking it off with pull ups–of course. Then we are hitting a little drop set to really tax the lats. Slow it down with some curls, and the closer is a great core circuit. Let’s do it!

3303.title: Glute-N-Full
3303.theWhy: Two awful movements. How is that for selling it? But man, our glutes are going to be strong as hell. You have lots of built in rest, so go heavy!

3304.title: Over the Shoulder Boulder Holder
3304.theWhy: Today’s focus is on shoulders and this gives us a little extra time to hit the core work at the end. Lucky you! We are hitting all three shoulder heads for “well-rounded” shoulders. Sticking with our usual flow…first we activate, then we go heavy, next we focus on imbalances, then accessories. Let’s build!

3305.title: Carried Away
3305.theWhy: Okay, I LOVE this workout! It is hard, but in the best way (that’s what she said). You are going to start with carries, which get your glutes and core. Then we hit some power with a “sled push.” Next, plyo work to keep us spry. Finish with more carry/core work. This workout is a little shorter, but that’s because it is intense. I’m not trying to stress your already stressed body. I’m trying to get you functionally strong, and this sucker will do just that!

3350.title: One Sided Story
3350.theWhy: Okay, buckle up. We have a lot of one-sided glute work today, hence the name. The benefit of this is we can really max out our glute muscles with a little less load on the spine. Plus, it really busts up asymmetries, because there is no cheating. This one offers some serious gains!

3351.title: The Pectoral College
3351.theWhy: Okay, we are starting to drop the number of reps on our big lift. This means go heavier. Lots of core work packed in today. Remember, upper body muscles are super cool, too!

3352.title: Princess Peach
3352.theWhy: Ready for glute dayyyyy? We’ve got deadlifts on tap. We are going a little heavier and dropping the reps. Your unilateral move is straight fire. You are in for a little treat.

3354.title: Carry On
3354.theWhy: One of the biggest tests of our longevity on planet earth is our grip strength. Today we test that! We have one big circuit that takes us through carries, “recovery” squats, and my favorite back and core exercise. Finish off with some weighted core. I hope you feel like a total baddie after this workout!!

3355.title: Legs Go!
3355.theWhy: Adding a little tempo work to maximize our leg gains. Today includes a lot of resistance band work. This will increase our muscle activation, but it is also like having a coach in the room with you to keep you honest. You’ll see what I mean.

3357.title: Lightning McQueen
3357.theWhy: You know the deal. We sprinting! We have lots of warm ups to get us ready. You know, we aren’t spring chickens. After your sprints, we move to some core stability work. Today is about grit and finishing what you start!

3358.title: A Positive Lat-titude
3358.theWhy: Strong backs are the best! We row, we curl, and we pull! Try to go as heavy as you can on the weighted moves. The last few reps should force you to make an ugly face!

3359.title: Guess Who’s Back?
3359.theWhy: First we do some tempo pull ups. These actually build more strength than traditional pull ups and are great for all levels. Then we work our lats some more with rows. The accessory work hits muscles you didn’t know you have. Finish with core work. It is a bit of a doozie, but it is also super fun!

3418.title: Tabata Takeover
3418.theWhy: This workout is a little shorter today, but it packs a lot of intensity. Today is all about spiking that heart rate and incorporating some jumping to help with our fast twitch muscles and bone density. We are doing this Tabata-style, meaning we work for 20 seconds and rest for 10 seconds. This makes it so we can really push ourselves! Plus, it isn’t boring!

3419.title: Whole Assed
3419.theWhy: Your glutes are going to be glute-ing after today! We are working a lot of single leg movements today to really work on asymmetries in the body and increase our balance. Make sure you aren’t wearing big, fluffy running shoes. More minimalist shoes really help with balance and strengthening through our whole kinetic chain!

3485.title: Flex Fest
3485.theWhy: Focus is on chest, triceps, and shoulders. We are really burning it up today. The upper body work is reasonable. We get a lot done in a short amount of time. This means we have a little extra time for core work. Our core work today involves weights and also really works the shoulders.

3486.title: Ready, Set, Carry
3486.theWhy: Today is challenging, but also fun. We are training for real life. Carries, hinges, and core! Plus, we have some plyometric work to help us with bone density and awesomeness. You have one big, giant circuit today. Pace yourself, but push yourself. Let’s do this!

3689.title: Curl Jam
3689.theWhy: We are busting out our resistance bands for this upper body workout. This is going to add some really good tension on both the squeeze (concentric) and release (eccentric) portion of the exercise. Work on your breath and core engagement with each exercise. Here we go!

3707.title: Flex Appeal
3707.theWhy: Another tabata to spike that heart rate and get your muscle burning. Tabatas are great at helping to build and increase stamina. We want to stay strong, energized, and ready to keep up with everything life throws our way!

3712.title: Thicccc Thighs
3712.theWhy: Lots of lunges and hinges. These are such important movement patterns in real life. Think of all the times you bend over to pick something up! We want to really use our workouts as the time to wire movement patterns in our brains!

3719.title: Thick Thighs Do (Literally) Save Lives
3719.theWhy: Okay, this is going to be fun. We are really hammering the quads. Glutes get an honorable mention. We are combining strength with a little plyometric “drop set” to really bring our muscles to fatigue. Finish off with some side booty and some core and pelvic floor love!

3721.title: ARMageddon
3721.theWhy: Working our back. We are hitting some knee on bench rows again, but doing less reps. So go even heavier. Remember, we are in our muscle-building era. We move into some back and shoulder duos. Finish with functional core exercises.

3722.title: Who Hurt You?
3722.theWhy: You know I love programming a good Tabata. We are hitting every muscle. Really push yourself today. This is where we build more muscle and more mind strength. We finish with some core work for a nice, quick, and dirty workout.

3723.title: Your Biggest Ass-et
3723.theWhy: This one is a doozie. Buckle up for leg and glute gains. We are really focusing a LOT on unilateral work to balance our bodies. We all have a “cheater” side. This workout keeps us honest. Not going to lie. This one takes a little grit, but I know you can do it!

3724.title: Pecs and the City
3724.theWhy: We are pushing and we are pressing! Main focus is on shoulders, but our chest is getting some love, too. Nice big exhales as you press. You can do this!

3725.title: Legs with Benefits
3725.theWhy: Lots of quads today, but don’t worry, the glutes still get their attention. We also give some love to our inner thighs and deep core. I’m not going to lie. Today’s session is an up in the challenge, but I know you can do this!

3726.title: Suspiciously Strong
3726.theWhy: Okay, our main circuit is five rounds, so buckle up. Lots of functional strength packed in. We press, we carry, and get stronger! Then a quick plyo circuit if your pelvic floor is up to it. If not, use the swap feature and let’s modify. Finish with some elevated core work…for a super well-rounded total body day!

3727.title: Dust Off Your Shoulders
3727.theWhy: Your shoulders have three heads. This workout gets them all for a finely chiseled looking shoulder. These are also great for range of motion and reducing frozen shoulders (a fun perimenopause symptom). The core work today gives special love (and by that I mean “burn”) to your low abs.

3728.title: The Thigh High Club
3728.theWhy: What a burner! We are really working those quads, but the glutes are getting so much work, too. We are doing some more single leg work to balance out these bodies. We finish with some plyo movements and static holds. No time for extra core work today, but don’t worry–we get plenty in our next session! All legs. All day.

3729.title: They Told Me to Clean
3729.theWhy: We slow things down a bit today and we really focus on form. Slow and steady wins the upper body gains race. Lots of rowing today, so please be sure to un-clench your butt cheeks when you hinge. I want this in your back muscles…not giving you an achy low back. Okay, let’s get er’ done.

3730.title: Ripped and Ready (For a Nap)
3730.theWhy: The whole workout is a big, fat Tabata. I program these because it allows us to both condition our bodies, while also strengthening them. We alternate between upper and lower body focused moves, and finish with a core movement. Enjoy!

3731.title: All Cheeked Up
3731.theWhy: All booty! You are going to be mad at me, because we are branching into super sets for our strength focus. The good news is…muscle growth and endurance! No time for direct core work today, but per usual, your next upper body session is packed with it. So really focus today on those glutes and hamstrings. Go heavy with that weight and bring those muscles to fatigue!

3732.title: Fire Lungs
3732.theWhy: Okay. We have an AMRAP that focuses on being explosive (not explosively swearing me out). Then we do a sled push finisher. I know your quads just recovered from the other day, so I’m sorry. Be sure to use your core for help. Finish with some low ab love. You got this!

3733.title: Pusher
3733.theWhy: First circuit gives lots of love to our back muscles. The second circuit focuses more on our chest. Together, these muscles help combat the hunched posture so many of us get from screens these days. And don’t let it fool you that the focus is mostly upper body. Each of these moves works the core, too!

3734.title: Ba Donka Donk
3734.theWhy: Hip thrust day. This exercise isn’t my fave to be honest, but it really helps us build strong glutes! So here we are, humping the air for those gains. We also have a lot of side booty work. This helps us build the shelf, but more importantly, it helps with knee, hip and back health!

3736.title: Raise the Roof
3736.theWhy: We are hitting our bench press for fewer reps, but with heavier weights. Let’s get it! Then we move into some chest and shoulder combo work. Core today is even more shoulders, but still tons of deep core. This workout is pretty chill, but don’t let it fool you. It is building muscle and sculpting our shoulders like a boss!

3739.title: Mile Thigh Club
3739.theWhy: This workout is fun, and I’m not lying to you like those influencers who promise cottage cheese tastes like cookie dough. We are doing split squats (but you said it would be fun!), and then on to step ups and some mobility work through our lateral movements. Core work requires big balls…I mean, a big ball… and gets those inner thighs and deep core in a special way.

3740.title: Endorphins are Coming
3740.theWhy: We are working on balance and leg stability. Nothing is more functional than the get-up from circuit 1. You might be thinking “Ummm, I can get up from a seat.” But can you do it with your feet staggered and actually recruit your glutes?! It gets spicy real quick!

3741.title: Tabata Know by Now
3741.theWhy: More tabata because I love you, that’s why. We are hitting allll legs, but don’t worry. We mix it up with quads, hamstrings, and side booty, so that no one muscle gets overly taxed. This is doable. I promise!

3742.title: Biceptual
3742.theWhy: I love this workout so much. These combos really get the back, biceps, core and even a little hamstring work! Focus on that contraction and use your breath.

3747.title: Everything & the Kitchen Sink
3747.theWhy: This class throws it all at you—in the best way possible! A total-body workout designed to challenge every muscle group, this session combines strength, endurance, balance, and flexibility to give you the ultimate barre experience.\u000A\u000AExpect a mix of small, controlled movements, larger functional exercises, and a sprinkle of cardio to keep your heart rate up. This workout is perfect for days when you want it all—the burn, the sweat, and the satisfaction of knowing you worked every inch of your body.\u000A\u000AIf you’re looking for the most well-rounded class that leaves no muscle behind, this is it!

3748.title: Flex Appeal
3748.theWhy: Combining flexibility and strength, this session helps unlock shoulder mobility while building upper body strength and a stable core for everyday activities.

3749.title: Strength in Motion
3749.theWhy: This class focuses on functional, lower-body strength exercises, helping participants move better and feel stronger in everyday life.

3750.title: Plie All Day
3750.theWhy: A class that blends barre’s signature plies with effective core work, targeting the thighs, glutes, pelvic muscles, and upper body for a graceful yet strong lower body.

3751.title: Muscles on the Mat
3751.theWhy: This class on the mat challenges your upper body and core in fun, creative ways. It’s all about staying connected—literally and figuratively—as you power through every move to build muscles for life.

3752.title: Thigh High
3752.theWhy: Say hello to long, strong legs! This class targets your thighs, hamstrings, and glutes with controlled movements that build both strength and grace. Perfect for boosting circulation and combating stiffness.

3753.title: The Total Package
3753.theWhy: This class is your all-in-one solution for strength, balance, endurance, and flexibility. It targets every major muscle group with controlled, intentional movements that improve posture and mobility. By incorporating both small, precise movements and larger functional exercises, this workout helps build lean muscle, enhance core stability, and keep your joints feeling strong and supported.

3754.title: Biceps & Balance
3754.theWhy: This class hones in on arm strength and balance work to improve posture and coordination, blending grace and grit into every move.

3755.title: Defy Gravity
3755.theWhy: Targeted lower-body movements to lift and shape your glutes while enhancing core stability. This workout helps prevent sagging and keeps everything feeling strong and lifted.

3757.title: From Tip to Toe
3757.theWhy: This head-to-toe workout is designed to strengthen, lengthen, and balance your entire body. By focusing on posture, alignment, and controlled movement, this class helps improve mobility, core stability, and overall body awareness. You'll target everything—arms, legs, glutes, and core—while incorporating flexibility work to keep your muscles supple and joints happy. Whether you're looking to move with more ease, stand taller, or simply feel amazing in your body, this class has you covered from (literally) tip to toe!

3758.title: Tri Me!
3758.theWhy: Solid upper body work with a heavy dose of core work. Your strength superset should bring you to failure, but I give you ample rest between sets. Then we tax those shoulders with light dumbbells that feel like a million pounds (someone explain it). Finish with band core work to really work on both anti-rotation (resisting the pull) and then rotation!

3759.title: She Strong
3759.theWhy: First circuit is all about power and digging deep. Your quads are going to burn. Second circuit is about stability and explosivity. The combo… super functional strength! Finish it off with a core and side booty set for a super powerful total body day!

3760.title: Quad Damn, My Thighs
3760.theWhy: This workout is the perfect blend of quads, glutes and inner thighs! Your core will be so happy and your glutes will be glute-ing. As always, we are doing a ton of single leg work. It helps address asymmetries, works our balance, and frankly…it really builds that junk in the trunk!

3761.title: On the ROW Again
3761.theWhy: Lots of back. A little posterior! This workout will feel “slower”, but trust the process. We are adding muscle and purposely adding time under tension.

3762.title: Whole Lotta Tabata
3762.theWhy: You know and LOVE tabatas! I got you! We are working various muscle groups, so you should have good stamina for the circuit.

3764.title: Just Thigh Me

equipment.itemSubtext: or something to hold on to like a doorframe
or another step that makes your thigh parallel to the ground

3764.theWhy: Okay, we are getting those glutes and hamstrings. We start with some symmetry building single leg work, then we follow it with MORE single leg work just to keep you honest. Oh, and more single leg work, because you know…this is how we make gains! Finish off with side booty work for more stable hips and happier knees. Here we go!

3765.title: Roasted Chestnuts
3765.theWhy: Pushes! We start with a shoulder press drop set. Next circuit is more about working the chest with a superset of bench and push ups. Finish with some anti-rotation core!

3766.title: Grand Finale
3766.theWhy: Let’s finish strong! We start with some power moves. It will tax you, but the rest of the workout is more about strength, so go big. I’m so proud of how hard you’ve worked. After today, take a nice deload week (go for walks, hike, yoga…but chill on the lifting). Then pick your next program!

3767.title: Drama Like Jerry Sprinter
3767.theWhy: It is sprint day. You pick your sprint medium–run, row, bike, ski erg. Then we slow it down and hit some super functional core work that will prep us to be strong ass old ladies.

3768.title: Growing Angel Wings

equipment.itemSubtext: or use a cable machine with light weight

3768.theWhy: Okay, let’s reflect on how much stronger your upper body is at this point by celebrating with some weighted pull ups! Hooray. Don’t worry, you can always modify. Then we row, build some biceps bro-style and end with some core stability work.

3776.title: Booty Duty…Not A Dookie Booty
3776.theWhy: Okay, working the big glute max and then finishing with a lottttt of glute med work (side booty). This is our final leg day in this workout split, sooooo… let’s prove how strong we are and show how far we’ve come!

3777.title: Armed and Shoulderous
3777.theWhy: Last shoulder day! I’m dying to know how much heavier your lifts have gotten. Tag me on Instagram and share your gains!! Okay, testing our shoulder press at 6 reps. Then you know we are going to give some love to the backs of our shoulders, too. Finish with a core work that incorporates plenty of shoulder work, too!

3778.title: Yes, MAM!
3778.theWhy: Final workout in this series! Say what?! We are ending with conditioning. Put those muscles to work! I am SO PROUD OF YOU!!!! Be sure to share your gains with me on social media. I really want to know what you’ve accomplished!!

3799.title: Uplift Your Spirit
3799.theWhy: Today we cultivate rajas—the uplifting energy that inspires motion, clarity, and renewed purpose. Ideal for times when you’re feeling low, stuck, or heavy, this class helps shift your state with intention and grace, leaving you feeling light, motivated, and more connected to yourself.

3801.theWhy: We will use movement and breath work to boost energy.

3802.title: Yoga for Headaches & Aches
3802.theWhy: Today’s practice is a soothing, restorative class for when the body is in pain and needs some nurturing. This isn’t about pushing through pain—it’s about honoring it with presence, patience, and softness.

3803.theWhy: Through breath work and poses that require focus, we will bring the mind to the present task and moment.\u000A\u000AThis class is all about the subtle work—small movements, big awareness. We’ll use breath and mindful positioning to explore how your pelvic floor and diaphragm work together, especially during transitions like menopause when connection can feel... fuzzy.

3805.title: Cooling Yoga for Hot Emotions
3805.theWhy: Through gentle, grounding poses and the steady rhythm of Ujjayi pranayama (ocean breath), you'll release internal heat, ease tension, and create space for clarity and compassion. Perfect for managing stress, anger, or overwhelm, this practice invites cooling energy, emotional balance, and a deep sense of inner calm.

3806.title: Pelvic Power Flow
3806.theWhy: Reconnect to your center in this grounding yoga class designed to stretch, strengthen, and restore balance to the pelvic floor. \u000A\u000AThrough mindful movement, breath work, and targeted poses, you'll gently release tension where there's tightness and build strength where there's weakness—supporting both hypertonic and hypotonic pelvic floor conditions. \u000A\u000AThis class promotes awareness, stability, and ease in the hips, core, and lower back, helping you feel more supported from the inside out.

3807.title: Yoga for Libido Lift
3807.theWhy: This slow, sensual yoga practice is designed to awaken energy in the pelvis, support your pelvic floor, and increase blood flow to the areas connected to libido and desire. Think of it as a gentle invitation to reconnect with yourself — no pressure, no expectations, just mindful movement that feels good from the inside out.\u000A\u000AThis class is beginner-friendly, with lots of options and props encouraged. Whether you’re experiencing shifts in libido, or just want to feel more alive and present in your body, this is your space to move, explore, and breathe.\u000A\u000ACome as you are. Move how you need. And maybe leave feeling a little more open, a little more vibrant, and a lot more you.

3808.title: Yoga to Counter Fatigue
3808.theWhy: Running on empty? This class is for the days when your body feels heavy, your mind is foggy, and even getting on your mat feels like a lot.\u000A\u000AWe’ll stay close to the ground with soothing breathwork and soft, supported stretches. A few poses offer the option to gently build heat—just enough to stir up a little “oomph” if you’re ready for it. But there’s zero pressure here. You can move, pause, or rest as your body needs. It’s not about pushing through—it’s about meeting yourself with compassion and creating space to shift.\u000A\u000AYou’ll leave feeling calmer, more grounded, and just a little more energized from the inside out.

3809.title: Yoga for Healthy Digestion
3809.theWhy: If your belly feels a little off—bloated, heavy, or just not quite right—this practice is here to help.\u000A\u000AThis class is especially helpful during times of digestive discomfort or sluggishness, and it’s designed with perimenopausal and menopausal bodies in mind. Modifications are offered throughout to support pelvic floor health and meet you exactly where you are today.\u000A\u000AYou’ll leave feeling more spacious, more grounded, and a little more at home in your body.

3810.title: Yoga to Calm Irritability
3810.theWhy: This calming flow was created for perimenopausal and menopausal women who feel edgy, overwhelmed, or like you might bite someone's head off (no judgment). We’ll start with soothing breath work to settle your nervous system, then move through feel-good stretches, grounding poses, and a little strength work to help shift that cranky energy into something more centered.\u000A\u000AYou'll loosen up your jaw, neck, hips, and attitude—with plenty of options and no pressure to be perfect. Whether you're stiff, snappy, or just need to move some energy, this class will meet you where you are.\u000A\u000AYou’ll finish feeling lighter, calmer, and way more like yourself again.

3840.theWhy: Lots of core work today. As you know by now–everything has an element of core in my workouts. This workout gives a little extra love though. Focus on power and stability. Here we go!
