3841.title: Cheeks Be Cheeky
3841.theWhy: Glute day!! Yes, please. Strong glutes are a pelvic floor’s BFF. As we age, we need to be sure that our whole body is supporting our pelvic floor. Glute workouts like this are essential.
3841.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A2 rounds\u000ASupported Block Heel Tap Down — 30 seconds right\u000ASupported Block Heel Tap Down — 30 seconds left\u000A\u000ARest — 30 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A3 rounds\u000ASupported Lunge — 30 seconds right\u000ASupported Lunge — 30 seconds left\u000AStanding Glute Med Abduction — 30 seconds right\u000AStanding Glute Med Abduction — 30 seconds left\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000A\u000ARest — 30 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 3\u000A3 rounds\u000ABall Squeeze Hip Thrust — 30 seconds\u000ABall Squeeze Hip Thrust Hold and Pulse — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds

3842.title: Arm-ed and Dangerous
3842.theWhy: Lots of tricep work today, but hey… no one was ever sad to have sculpted arms. We are taking our push ups up a notch with some knee ins and mimicking this movement pattern with tricep dips. Then we have some band work to seal the deal.
3842.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A3 rounds\u000APush Up with 1-2 Knee — 30 seconds\u000ADip to Knee In — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000A\u000ARest — 30 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A3 rounds\u000AWall Tricep Push Up — 30 seconds\u000AMini Band Pull Apart — 30 seconds\u000AMini Band Pull Apart Hold — 15 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000A\u000ARest — 30 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 3\u000A2 rounds\u000ADeadbug Prep — 30 seconds\u000AKneeling Walk Out — 30 seconds

3843.title: Gotta Tabata
3843.theWhy: More tabata. I know. I know. But do you feel yourself getting stronger? Have you noticed more stamina? This is why!! We are alternating between upper and lower body moves, so that means you can go really hard on each of these tabatas!
3843.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000ATabata 1 — Low Lateral Walk / Speed Skater\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000ATabata 2 — Bodyweight Upper Woodchops (R/L)\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000ATabata 3 — Shoulder Taps / Plank Marches\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000ATabata 4 — 1-Leg Extensions / Bridges

3848.title: Glute Me Baby One More Time
3848.theWhy: More hinge work. We hinge all day every day and dang it, I want you to be able to do it with stability in your core and strength from your glutes. We are finishing with inner thigh work to really activate our low abs and pelvic floor.
3848.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A3 rounds\u000AStanding Airplanes — 30 seconds right\u000AStanding Airplanes — 30 seconds left\u000A1.5 Rep Squats — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000A\u000ARest — 30 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A3 rounds\u000AFoot On Wall Hip Hinge — 30 seconds right\u000AFoot On Wall Hip Hinge — 30 seconds left\u000A2 Lateral Steps, 1 Squat Jump — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000A\u000ARest — 30 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 3\u000A2 rounds\u000ALeaning Inner Thigh Ball Squeeze — 30 seconds\u000AKneeling Hip Thrust with Ball Squeeze — 30 seconds

3849.title: Are Those Legal?
3849.theWhy: We start with bicep work and then move to tricep work. This means you can really work each muscle group knowing that a break is coming. Finish with some cross-body core work, which is the ultimate back pain prevention hack!
3849.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A4 rounds\u000AStanding Band Curl — 30 seconds\u000AStanding Band Curl Hold — 30 seconds\u000ABent Over Band Row — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000A\u000ARest — 30 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A3 rounds\u000ATricep Extension Overhead — 30 seconds\u000AStanding Band Chest Fly — 30 seconds\u000AStanding Band Front Raise — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000A\u000ARest — 30 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 3\u000A2 rounds\u000ABird Dog Band Reach — 30 seconds right\u000ABird Dog Band Reach — 30 seconds left

3850.title: Swole Sisters
3850.theWhy: This tabata really focuses on cardio. It is a heated one. We are adding in a little jumping (but I do show a modification if your pelvic floor isn’t up for it). Jumping helps us with bone density. We naturally start to lose bone density after age 30, but smart training keeps our body young!
3850.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000ATabata 1 — Lunge to Hinge\u000ARest — 45 seconds\u000ATabata 2 — Push Up to Jack\u000ARest — 45 seconds\u000ATabata 3 — Squat Jump\u000ARest — 45 seconds\u000ATabata 4 — Elevated 3-Point Plank\u000ARest — 45 seconds

3851.title: Gluteus Maxed
3851.theWhy: Today’s workout is about slowing down and focusing on the contraction and the hold. We are focusing on activating our glute muscles with each bridge. As we work on our holds, we are not holding our breath. I coach you through it and remind you to breathe. It is a perfect life lesson–when something gets hard, breathe through it.
3851.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A5 rounds\u000AFeet Elevated Bridge — 30 seconds\u000AFeet Elevated Bridge Hold — 30 seconds\u000A\u000ARest — 30 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A4 rounds\u000AWall Sit Hold — 30 seconds\u000ACaptain Morgan Calf Raises — 30 seconds right\u000ACaptain Morgan Calf Raises — 30 seconds left\u000A\u000ARest — 30 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 3\u000A3 rounds\u000ADiagonal Forward Bounds/Walk Back — 60 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000A\u000ARest — 30 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 4\u000A2 rounds\u000AClam on Crack — 30 seconds right\u000ASide Lying Leg Lift — 30 seconds right\u000AClam on Crack — 30 seconds left\u000ASide Lying Leg Lift — 30 seconds left

3852.title: You're Pushing It, Lady
3852.theWhy: Okay, another layer to the push up. Can you pause for a couple seconds and get yourself back out of it? Let’s see! We have a great mix of chest, tricep and core today!
3852.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A4 rounds\u000APush Up with 2 Second Pause — 30 seconds\u000APlank Row — 30 seconds\u000AElevated Rock Backs — 30 seconds\u000AKneeling Tricep Press on Bench — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000A\u000ARest — 30 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A3 rounds\u000AHeel Drops — 30 seconds\u000ASide Lying Internal External Rotation — 30 seconds right\u000ASide Lying Internal External Rotation — 30 seconds left

3853.title: Totally Strong
3853.theWhy: A little impact for bone density, some anti-rotation for core stability, and some unilateral work to address imbalances. Final day in this workout series. I just have to say–I AM SO PROUD OF YOU!!!
3853.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000ATabata 1 — Lunge Drive Hop R/L\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000ATabata 2 — Tricep Dips/Shoulder Taps\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000ATabata 3 — B-Stance Hip Thrust R/L\u000A\u000ARest — 30 seconds between circuits\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A2 rounds\u000A1-Leg Extension — 60 seconds (alternating)\u000ARest — 20 seconds

480.title: A Beautiful Sample Workout
480.theWhy: Because Stephen needs to see every beautiful circuit type that we have.

5399.title: No More Rib Bewb
5399.theWhy: Feel like your rib cage is wider? Ribs flared? Upper diastasis recti that won't improve? We are working to get our ribs in better position. You need a long band anchored low onto something sturdy, and a medium dumbbell.
5399.circuitsCopy: 3 Rounds\u000ABand Pull Over — 30 Seconds\u000ABand Pull Hold with Bridge — 30 Seconds\u000ACrossbody Band Pulls — 30 Seconds Right\u000ACrossbody Band Pulls — 30 Seconds Left\u000AWeight Hold with Heel Taps — 60 Seconds\u000ARest — 30 Seconds

5400.title: Low Abs, Are You There?!
5400.theWhy: The elusive low abs. A lot of us women struggle the very most to connect with this part of our core because of pressure system imbalances, and sometimes a disconnection from a c-section (even if it was a million years ago).
5400.circuitsCopy: 3 Rounds\u000ABridge with Ball Squeeze — 30 Seconds\u000ABall Behind Back Marches — 60 Seconds\u000AQuadruped Hover with Ball Squeeze — 30 Seconds\u000ACrossbody Ball Press — 30 Seconds Right\u000ACrossbody Ball Press — 30 Seconds Left\u000ARest — 15 Seconds

5401.title: Six Package
5401.theWhy: Our core should help us do three things: stabilize the spine, generate power, and keep our insides...in. This core workout teaches you to do all three! You'll need an elevated surface like a bench or sofa.
5401.circuitsCopy: 3 Rounds\u000AElevated Hover with Rotation — 30 Seconds\u000AElevated Plank with Hover Step In — 30 Seconds\u000AHip Thrust Hold with March — 30 Seconds\u000ABlast Off Knee Drive — 30 Seconds\u000AShoulder Taps — 30 Seconds\u000ARest — 15 Seconds

5402.title: Lean In
5402.theWhy: We are hitting the internal and external oblique muscles (the side body muscles). We are also working on mindfully rotating using power from our hips! Set your band about shin-height and let's work.
5402.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000ALow to High Band Woodchop — 30 Seconds Right\u000ALow to High Band Woodchop — 30 Seconds Left\u000AStanding Leaning Band Pull — 30 Seconds Right\u000AStanding Leaning Band Pull — 30 Seconds Left\u000ASide Plank with Row — 30 Seconds Right\u000ASide Plank with Row — 30 Seconds Left\u000ARest — 30 Seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A\u000A1 Round\u000ABand Stir the Pot — 60 Seconds

5403.title: I Carry My Own Groceries
5403.theWhy: If there is one thing you should master, it is how to carry a weighted load without putting pressure on your pelvic floor or out against your core muscles. Today, we get a lot of practice. Don't worry. I cue you every step of the way. Grab a medium/heavy dumbbell.\u000A\u000AIf supporting yourself on your wrists doesn’t feel great, grab a bench or sturdy chair to elevate your hands.
5403.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A3 Rounds\u000AGoblet Hold March — 30 Seconds\u000ASuitcase Carry — 30 Seconds Right\u000ASuitcase Carry — 30 Seconds Left\u000ABear Crawl In Place — 30 Seconds\u000ARest — 30 Seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A\u000A1 Round\u000AKneeling Press Out — 60 Seconds

5404.title: Press On
5404.theWhy: Another day dedicated to helping us get our ribs in a better position. Today we use feedback from a squishy ball and a long resistance band.
5404.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A3 Rounds\u000ALean Back Palm Ball Squeeze — 30 Seconds\u000ABird Dog Limbs Down — 30 Seconds Right\u000ABird Dog Limbs Down — 30 Seconds Left\u000A\u000ARest — 30 Seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000ACrossbody Band Pull — 30 Seconds Right\u000ACrossbody Band Pull — 30 Seconds Left\u000APalms Up Band Pull Apart — 30 Seconds\u000ARest — 30 Seconds

5405.title: Im-press-ive
5405.theWhy: We are passing the weight! Why? Well, it teaches your core to stabilize you as your center of gravity shifts. This is going to keep us strong for life. You need a medium dumbbell and a long band anchored about hip height.
5405.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000AGorilla Passes — 60 Seconds\u000AStaggered Stance DB Curl Press — 30 Seconds Right\u000AStaggered Stance DB Curl Press — 30 Seconds Left\u000ARest — 30 Seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000APallof 4 Step Press — 30 Seconds Right\u000APallof 4 Step Press — 30 Seconds Left\u000AOverhead Hold with March — 30 Seconds\u000ARest — 15 Seconds

5406.title: Two Pac Shakur
5406.theWhy: Lots of leg lowering today! Yes, you will feel some of this in your hip flexors, but the low abs should be the super star. The foam roller/towel under your backside is going to help you take some pressure off the pelvic floor and really lock in to that low ab mind/muscle connection by requiring a greater range of motion.
5406.circuitsCopy: 3 Rounds\u000A1-Leg Extension — 30 Seconds Right\u000A1-Leg Extension — 30 Seconds Left\u000AHeel Taps — 60 Seconds\u000AFrog Pulls — 30 Seconds\u000ARest — 30 Seconds

5407.title: Side Body Baddie
5407.theWhy: Lots of options depending on where your body is a in its core strength. The focus is on that anterior oblique sling to increase our athleticism. I don't care if you fancy yourself an athlete or not. If you are here, you are!! You need a long band anchored about hip high and you have the option to grab a tiny weight.
5407.circuitsCopy: 3 Rounds\u000AKneeling Band Across — 30 Seconds Right\u000AKneeling Band Across — 30 Seconds Left\u000ASide Plank Hold — 30 Seconds Right\u000ASide Plank Hold — 30 Seconds Left\u000ARunner's Lunge with Band Pull — 30 Seconds Right\u000ARunner's Lunge with Band Pull — 30 Seconds Left\u000ARest — 30 Seconds

5408.title: Carry Me Home
5408.theWhy: Functional core at its finest. We are carrying things, passing things, and taking weight out from our body. And we are going to do it with good breathing and deep core engagement! This is the skill you need and want. Your back will thank you. Grab a light/medium dumbbell. I'm using a pad to kneel on but you can also use a folded up yoga mat under your knees.

5416.title: Totally Calm
5416.theWhy: Because we wanna be totally calm.

5441.title: Nidra 1
5441.theWhy: Settle in for a deeply restful Yoga Nidra practice focused on releasing physical tension and finding comfort in stillness. You’ll be guided to notice your breath, soften your muscles, and connect with a sense of safety and ease—perfect for winding down before bed or after a stressful day.
5441.circuitsCopy: Release tension and find comfort in stillness with this deeply restful Yoga Nidra. Perfect for unwinding before bed or after a stressful day.

5443.title: Nidra 2
5443.theWhy: This calming Yoga Nidra session helps you tune into your body’s signals and release built-up tension in both body and mind. Through breath awareness and mindful scanning, you’ll soothe your nervous system, promote a sense of balance, and create space for clarity and calm.
5443.circuitsCopy: Soothe your body and calm your mind through gentle breath awareness and body scanning. A short, guided reset for clarity and balance.

5444.title: Nidra 3
5444.theWhy: A full-body relaxation journey designed to help you let go completely. This Yoga Nidra class uses gentle imagery and breathwork to quiet your mind, reduce stress, and leave you feeling restored from the inside out. Ideal for days when you need to pause, recharge, and come back to yourself.
5444.circuitsCopy: Let go completely with this full-body relaxation journey. Quiet your mind, ease stress, and feel restored from the inside out.

5445.title: Nidra 4
5445.theWhy: Get comfy, close your eyes, and let’s find your calm. This Yoga Nidra is designed for midlife women who need a reset—body, mind, and soul. In just 20 minutes, we’ll melt away tension, quiet your thoughts, and help you feel more grounded and at ease. You deserve this time.
5445.circuitsCopy: Settle in for 20 minutes of guided rest. This Yoga Nidra will calm your mind, release tension, and leave you feeling deeply refreshed.

5446.title: Nidra 5
5446.theWhy: Press pause on the day and settle into deep rest. This guided Yoga Nidra invites you to relax fully, release tension, and plant a powerful intention for yourself. Through breath, body awareness, and calming imagery, you’ll drift into that sweet space between wakefulness and sleep—where true restoration begins. No effort needed, just lie back, listen, and let the practice carry you into stillness.
5446.circuitsCopy: Through gentle breath, body awareness, and soothing imagery, you’ll drift into the space between wakefulness and sleep—where real restoration happens. Just lie back, listen, and let yourself rest.

5447.title: Balanced Energy
5447.theWhy: Balance hormones, calm the nervous system, and resore mental clarity.
5447.circuitsCopy: — Sit comfortably with a long spine and relaxed shoulders.\u000A— Bring your right hand to your face, resting index and middle fingers between your eyebrows.\u000A— Close the right nostril with your thumb and inhale slowly through the left.\u000A— Close the left nostril with your ring finger, release your thumb, exhale through the right.\u000A— Inhale right → close → exhale left.\u000A— Continue the pattern: inhale left → exhale right → inhale right → exhale left.\u000A— Keep the breath slow, smooth, and even—no rush.\u000A— After 5 minutes, release your hand, breathe naturally, and notice the grounded calm and balance.

5449.title: Inner Vibration
5449.theWhy: Relieve tension, soothe anxiety, and activate inner calm.
5449.circuitsCopy: — Sit tall or lie down comfortably, eyes soft or closed.\u000A— Inhale slowly through your nose.\u000A— Exhale with a gentle **humming sound—like a bee—**and feel the vibration in your head and chest.\u000A— Keep the lips sealed, jaw relaxed, and teeth slightly apart.\u000A— Rest your hands on your heart or belly to sense the resonance.\u000A— Continue: inhale nose → exhale hum.\u000A— If the mind drifts, return to the sound and vibration.\u000A— After ~5 minutes, let the humming dissolve into quiet, carrying that calm inner buzz with you.

5450.title: Calm Control
5450.theWhy: Reduce stress, improve focus, and ground your energy.
5450.circuitsCopy: — Sit comfortably, eyes soft or closed, one hand resting on your belly.\u000A— Inhale through the nose for 4.\u000A— Hold for 4.\u000A— Exhale through the nose for 4.\u000A— Hold for 4.\u000A— Visualize a square:\u000A inhale → up • hold → across • exhale → down • hold → across.\u000A— Maintain the steady rhythm: in 4 | hold 4 | out 4 | hold 4.\u000A— After ~5 minutes, return to natural breathing—grounded, centered, calm.

5451.title: Still & Strong
5451.theWhy: Deep rest, release tension, and reconnect with inner strength.
5451.circuitsCopy: — Lie on your back, legs extended, arms relaxed beside you, palms open to receive.\u000A— Take one slow inhale, then exhale fully—softening the body\u000A— Let the breath return to its natural rhythm.\u000A— Gently scan from head to toes, noticing sensation without judgment.\u000A— With each exhale, imagine sinking deeper—held, supported, safe.\u000A— Thoughts may drift in; let them pass like clouds.\u000A— Rest in quiet stillness for ~5 minutes.\u000A— When ready, deepen your breath, wiggle fingers and toes, and rise slowly—carrying calm with you.

5452.title: Empowered Vision
5452.theWhy: Build positivity, reduce stress, and reconnect with your empowered self.
5452.circuitsCopy: — Sit or lie down comfortably, eyes closed. Inhale deeply, then exhale slowly.\u000A— Imagine a place where you feel completely safe and at ease—perhaps a beach, forest, quiet room, or blooming garden.\u000A— Notice the details: colors, textures, sounds, scents, warmth, air. Let the scene come alive around you.\u000A— With every inhale, draw in peace, strength, and possibility.\u000A— With every exhale, release stress and tension.\u000A— Now picture your future self—strong, vibrant, confident. See her moving with ease, joy, and self-trust.\u000A— Hold this image gently, letting it fill your whole body.\u000A— Choose a word to carry with you—peace, strength, balance, empowerment, or your own.\u000A— When you're ready, open your eyes, bringing that vision and word forward with you into the day.

5477.title: Hamstrung
5477.theWhy: Let’s kick things off! We are working on our hinge (lengthened glute work) and hip thrusts (shortened glute work). Then we toss in some shoulders, hitting all three shoulder heads. Lots of core work snuck in.

5489.title: Back-tivate
5489.theWhy: Feeling a little hunched lately? This one’s for you.\u000ARows and bands counter all the sitting, driving, and computer hunching we do.\u000AWe sneak in deep core work at the end so your posture and breath start working together again. Think proud chest, big exhales, and letting your back do the work.

5490.title: Quad Damn
5490.theWhy: Well, it is quad and glute day. We are doing our first every minute on the minute workout. It makes for a fun challenge. We finish with some power moves and holds, a spicy combo.

5491.title: Rack Attack
5491.theWhy: We are working on our “push”. But just because we are pushing…doesn’t mean we are pushing out against our core or pelvic floor. Remember, big exhale on the hard part of each move. Lots of anti-rotation work to bullet-proof our core.

5493.title: Muscle Mastery
5493.theWhy: This is a shorter workout, but don’t let it fool you. We accomplish a lot! We are doing this Tabata style. That means 20 seconds on and 10 seconds of rest. It is the best way to build endurance.

5494.title: Excuse Me, MAM
5494.theWhy: Working that backside! Lots of glutes. Lots of hammies. We are hitting a lot of single leg work to address asymmetries and truly build strong and symmetrical glutes. No cheater side taking over!

5495.title: Lat-it-tude
5495.theWhy: The perfect back workout. You won’t hate me for this one, as it is mostly strength focused. We are working out lats (big back muscle), biceps and ending with a core/bicep duo.

5496.title: Built to Bounce
5496.theWhy: Okay, we start off with a strength duet that gets the quads and then the hamstrings/inner thighs. Next, you go for power. Working on those fast twitch muscle fibers keeps our bodies young. It is medicine! Finish with a crossbody core session to really protect you from back pain.

5497.title: Power Push
5497.theWhy: We are pressing and we are pushing! Today might feel a little challenging push ups aren’t your thing, but I want you to know, you can always use a higher surface, even the wall. You will get stronger and stronger throughout this program. I can’t wait for you to shock yourself in another few weeks!

5500.title: Full Body Futureproof
5500.theWhy: Working literally every muscle. We are building strength, improving our endurance, and challenging ourselves! We are doing this workout Tabata style…meaning you work for 20 seconds, rest for 10 seconds and repeat. This is a great way to build strength and stamina!!

5512.title: Half-Assed
5512.theWhy: Lots of glutes today! We are doing our glute work unilaterally, meaning one side at a time. This will make us ninjas in the long run, but it does make the exercises a little harder in the moment (prevents you from cheating your dominant side). I’m with you every step of the way. Let’s go burn that booty!

5513.title: Back to the Future
5513.theWhy: Yes, back and biceps. But also yes…lots of core. Today’s workout is a solid combination of “bro” strength and functional strength training to make real life easier.

5514.title: Get Up and Go
5514.theWhy: Lots of squat variations to really fire up our quads and activate all the muscles that help stabilize the knees. Our work is extra functional. We are training for our future!

5515.title: Press Release: Strong AF
5515.theWhy: How much stronger have you gotten over the past few weeks? Can you go up in weight a little bit on those 1-arm bench presses? I bet you can! We finish with important core work…carries. Grip strength is a huge predictor of longevity and health. Nothing gets your body stronger than carrying heavy things!

5516.title: Metabolic Muscle Maker
5516.theWhy: Lots of shoulders packed in this one! But it is total body and we have a solid mix of strength and conditioning. Finish with some stabilizer muscles (inner thighs!) and mindful deep core work.

5518.title: Kiss My A$$
5518.theWhy: Okay, we start with some side booty work to tell our knees and hips to track better during our movements. Then we hit some hinges and shoulder presses. We work more posterior chain with hamstring curls and bridges. And you know we have to sneak in a little plyo work for bone density.

5519.title: Don't BACK Out
5519.theWhy: A strong back means better posture and better breathing! We are hitting our one-sided rows, but doing them slowwwwly. We double up on the lats with some pull downs…stay tall. Finish with some curls and then some deep core work for a really strong and healthy posterior.

5520.title: Leg's Go!
5520.theWhy: Ohhh, your quads are going to burn, but guess what…we are also adding mass to dat ass. Lots of single leg work and then we finish with some power plyo moves.

5521.title: Pressin' and Pushin'
5521.theWhy: This one is a smidge longer than 30 minutes. Sorry!

5522.title: What Doesn't Kill Me...
5522.theWhy: Oooof, conditioning day. I know. I know. This one is pretty fun though. We start with some functional strength for our first circuit and then we do some “spike our heart rate” and “build our bones” conditioning.

5524.title: Glute Camp
5524.theWhy: Gloooot day. Okay, we are practicing our split squats again. I know these are fun to hate, but nothing builds better glutes. Our other focus today is our side booty. This is important for our hips and our knees! Of course, lots of love for the core and pelvic floor throughout each of the circuits.

5525.title: Back Up
5525.theWhy: We are doing our knee on bench rows, but making it a drop set. This will really build a strong back. For our accessory work we are hitting the backs of our shoulders and our lats. We burn it up with a killer curl set using a band. Finish with deep core and side body work.

5526.title: Mile Thigh Club
5526.theWhy: This workout is fire! It is the perfect mix or burn-the-crap-out-of-your-quads mixed with glute-building. We are using a mix of bands and weights to really get the job done. Have fun and push yourself! You can!

5527.title: Im-Press-Ive
5527.theWhy: Today we are working on a new skill. Keeping our ribs down when we lift weight or add tension overhead! It can help to watch yourself in a mirror! Lots of chest and tricep work today. Go up in weight on your bench press if you can!

5528.title: Longevity Lifts
5528.theWhy: Today is funnnn! Like, for real…fun. We have a couple of Tabatas for our strength movement. Then we hit some plyometric work for cardio capacity and bone health. Finish with some grip strength work. Grip strength is a huge indicator of longevity and quality of life. Functional strength training at its finest today.

5529.title: RidiculASS
5529.theWhy: Loads of single leg glute work today. Your body will thank you. The benefit of single leg work is it addresses asymmetries in the body. Also, because we are only loading one side, it works the muscle better–less cheating from the strong side.

5530.title: Hard Flex
5530.theWhy: Biceps are kind of the superstar today. Of course we are targeting the back and deep core, too. Really focus on squeezing those back muscles on each rep. Don’t rush today. Focus on the muscle contraction instead

5531.title: Thick Thighs Actually Do Save Lives
5531.theWhy: Thick thighs really do save lives. Strong legs are correlated to longevity! And well, it is split squats today. Hate them all you’d like, but they build a phenomenal backside! Today we combine strength, power, and endurance. You’ve come a long way. Make this final leg day of the program really count!

5532.title: Armed and Dangerous
5532.theWhy: I hope you are feeling so dang strong! We are doing some floor bench press…one sided for more core. Then we have some power moves that really fire up the core. We finish with…you guessed it…even more core-centric movements. Cheers to a strong upper body and super functional core!

5533.title: The Grand Finale
5533.theWhy: We have one main, big circuit today and it hits every muscle. It is a true combo of strength and cardio. You will love/hate me for this one, but I wanted us to finish strong. When you hit “complete workout” today, I want you to reflect on just how dang far you’ve come!

5539.title: Yoga Nidra Body & Mind
5539.theWhy: Settle into stillness and let this guided yoga nidra help your body and mind fully unwind. Lying comfortably with simple support under your head and knees, you’ll be guided through breath awareness, gentle visualization, and deep rest designed to calm the nervous system and quiet a busy mind. This practice is perfect for days when you feel wired, tired, or overstimulated-and especially helpful before bed or anytime you need true, restorative rest without effort.

5578.title: Yoga Flow for Pain Free Lower Back
5578.theWhy: Grab a tennis ball (or myofascial release ball) and a pillow, and we’ll gently unwind the low back and hip flexors-two areas that love to complain in midlife. Expect slow, steady breathwork, targeted release (never on the spine), and an easy yoga flow to help everything feel more open, supported, and “ahhh.” Options are built in, so you can keep it comfortable and still get the benefits.
5578.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000A-MFR For Low Back\u000A-Table Top\u000A-Cat/ Cow\u000A-Downward Facing Dog\u000A-Crescent Lunge Variations\u000A-Mini Side Angle Pose\u000A-Supported Side Plank\u000A-Threaded Shoulder\u000A-Gate Pose\u000A-Bird Dog\u000A-MFR for Iliopsoas

5587.title: Inner & Outer Leg Line Yoga Flow for Healthy Hips
5587.theWhy: Hip tension? Let’s take it down a notch. This quick myofascial release + yoga flow uses a tennis/lacrosse ball to work the outer hip line (yes, that spicy IT-band-adjacent area) and the inner thigh line to help everything feel less “stuck.” You’ll learn how to find the right amount of pressure (think: intense-but-breathable), then follow it up with simple yoga moves to get blood flow back in and help your hips move more freely.
5587.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow:\u000A\u000A— MFR for IT Band & Outer Thighs\u000A— Mini Circulation Flow with Adduction\u000A— MFR for Adductors & Inner Thighs

5588.title: Myofascial Release: Feet, Lower Legs, and Neck
5588.theWhy: This quick release routine is your “exhale, unclench, carry on” session. \u000A\u000AStart with simple ball work for the bottoms of the feet and calves (hello, sneaky tension), then finishes with a gentle neck release using two balls in a sock under the base of the skull—amazing for end-of-day tightness and those “why am I holding stress in my eyebrows?” moments. You’ll keep intensity in a breathable 4–7/10, with options to make it softer or spicier.
5588.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000A— MFR for the Bottoms of the Feet\u000A— MFR for the Calves\u000A— MRF for the Cervical Spine

5589.title: Myofascial Release + Yoga Flow for Shoulders
5589.theWhy: Shoulders feeling crunchy, tight, or stuck? Let’s get you some space. This class uses a tennis ball to release the front of the chest and shoulder (hello, desk posture), then guides you through a slow, breath-led mobility flow to get blood moving and help your shoulders glide again. You’ll finish with two balls in a sock along the upper back-right around shoulder-blade level-for that “bra-strap tension” kind of relief.
5589.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000A— Table Top\u000A— Cat/Cow\u000A— Downward Dog\u000A— Crescent Lunge Variations\u000A— Half Splits\u000A— Mini Camel Pose\u000A— MFR for Upper Back

5590.title: Tension Free Abdomen + Yoga for a Healthy Core
5590.theWhy: Feeling tight in your belly-like you’re holding stress in a clenched fist? This gentle routine uses a tennis ball and your hands to release the upper and lower abdomen with slow, steady breathing. You’ll stay in a “spicy but breathable” zone (no hero points here), then move through an easy flow to create space and circulation. Think: calmer belly, easier movement, and a little “ahhh” for your whole system.\u000A\u000AQuick note: Skip if you have sharp pain, a hernia, recent abdominal surgery, or anything feels “off.” Keep it comfortable and breathable.
5590.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000A— MRF for Upper Abdomen\u000A— Mini Circulation Flow\u000A— MRF for the Four Quadrants of the Belly

5591.title: Wrist Relief
5591.theWhy: Your wrists and thumbs do the most-phones, laptops, groceries, and the occasional “why is this jar sealed like Fort Knox?” This release session uses a ball and a firm surface to melt tension in your forearms, hands, traps, and thumbs so gripping and pressing feels easier. Go slow, hunt for the “sweet spot,” breathe through it, and let your body say “thank you” in real time.
5591.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000A— Outside Forearm Release (Left)\u000A— Inside Forearm Release (Left)\u000A— Outside Forearm Release (Right)\u000A— Inside Forearm Release (Right)\u000A— Trap and Neck Ball Massage (both sides)\u000A— Thumb Smash

5593.title: Ankle Flexion
5593.theWhy: This short mobility session focuses on one of the most overlooked joints in the body: your ankles. Limited ankle mobility can change how you squat, lunge, walk, and even how your low back feels during workouts. In this flow, you’ll use a chair, wall, and foam roller to gently improve ankle range of motion, release tight calves, and practice controlled knee-over-toe movement. The result? Better squat depth, smoother movement patterns, and less compensation from your hips and back. It’s a simple, feel-good routine that helps everything above your ankles work better too.
5593.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000A-Foot on Bench Leans\u000A-Wall Calf Stretch\u000A-Ankle Circles on Foam Roller\u000A-Knee to Wall Lunges

5618.title: Gentle Neck and Twist Flow
5618.theWhy: Unwind tight shoulders, cranky wrists, and stiff hips with this gentle mobility flow designed to support the areas that commonly feel restricted in midlife. You’ll move through breath, wrist and neck warm-ups, supported stretches, a simple yoga sequence, and light balance work to reconnect to stability and core control.\u000A\u000AHave diastasis or prolapse? Keep twists small, stay comfortable, and keep your core engaged. Modifications are shown throughout so you can make this fit your body today.
5618.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000ANeck Release\u000AWrist Stretches\u000ADownward Dog\u000AForward Fold with Rag Doll\u000AGorilla\u000AForward Fold Twist\u000AWarrior II + Flow\u000AWindshield Wiper Legs\u000AHalf Frog\u000ABalance Work

5619.title: Heart Opener Flow
5619.theWhy: If your back feels stiff, your hips feel tight, and your shoulders are basically living up by your ears-press play.\u000A\u000AThis mobility flow moves through spinal mobility, gentle twists, hip openers, and a little core + pelvic floor connection so you feel supported (not wrung out). Expect a full-body “ahhhh” for your joints.\u000A\u000AKeep twists small if you have diastasis or pelvic floor symptoms, stay in a comfortable range, and let this be your reminder: you don’t need to go farther-you need to move smarter.
5619.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000ATabletop Opener\u000ACat/Cow\u000AChild's Pose\u000AKnee Sit + Cactus Arms\u000AFingers Chest Stretch\u000ADownard Dog\u000AHigh Lunge Twist\u000AYogi Squat

5620.title: Leg Release Flow
5620.theWhy: Give your legs the reset they’ve been asking for. This calming flow moves through gentle spine mobility, down dog, lunges, and deep hip and hamstring stretches to release built-up tension from hips, quads, and the backs of the legs. Expect a mix of steady movement and longer holds, with options to use blocks and padding so you can meet your body exactly where it is today.
5620.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000AChild's Pose\u000ACobra Shoulder Press with Dips\u000ACat/Cow\u000ATabletop Side Reach\u000AThread the Needle\u000ADownward Dog Flow\u000ALow Lunge to Lizard\u000AHalf Split Fold\u000ASingle Leg Forward Fold\u000ALow Lunge\u000AArthur's Seat

5621.title: Shoulder Release
5621.theWhy: This flow is all about opening the places we tend to “carry the day”-shoulders and hips. Expect a steady, feel-good sequence that builds a little heat, then melts you into deep, satisfying stretches. You’ll move through down dog, lunges, squats, and hip openers that help restore range of motion, release tension, and leave you feeling lighter and more mobile. This is a great one for days when your upper body feels tight, your hips feel stuck, or you simply want a yoga session that helps you move and breathe better from head to toe.
5621.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000ADownward Dog to Dolphin Flow\u000A1/2 Puppy\u000ADownward Dog Sequence\u000AHorizon Flow\u000AYogi Squat + Twist\u000AWindshield Wiper Legs

5622.title: Use Your Power for Chest and Core
5622.theWhy: If your shoulders feel glued to your ears and your chest has been living in “desk posture,” this one is your reset.\u000A\u000AYou’ll open up the front of the body (hello, pecs), wake up your core without crunching your soul, and finish with hip stretches that make walking upstairs feel less like a personal attack. Expect side stretches, a juicy shoulder opener, boat pose options, reclined pigeon, and a little warrior series + balance work (blocks welcome-zero shame, all strategy).\u000A\u000AGo slow, stay in a comfortable range, and let this be your reminder: mobility is not extra credit. It’s the foundation.
5622.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000AMountain Pose Flow\u000ASide Bends\u000AChest Stretch\u000AReverse TT Stretch\u000A1/2 Happy Baby\u000AReclined Pigeon\u000ADownward Dog + Warrior Flow\u000AEasy Seat

5623.title: Lower Body Recovery Yoga Practice
5623.theWhy: Tight hips. Achy low back. Legs that feel like they’ve been sitting since 1997. This gentle yoga flow is your reset button.\u000A\u000AYou’ll move through supported hip openers, hamstring stretches, and quad releases while reconnecting to your breath and core in a way that feels calming-not taxing. Expect slow transitions, plenty of prop options, and poses that help your body unwind while your nervous system finally exhales.\u000A\u000APerfect for days when you want to feel looser, lighter, and more balanced from the ground up.
5623.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000AModified Sun Salutations\u000APigeon Pose\u000ASeated Hamstring Stretch

5624.title: Upper Body Recovery Yoga Practice
5624.theWhy: Melt tension from your neck, shoulders, and upper back with this short recovery-focused flow. We’ll use a strap (or long band) for gentle shoulder openers, move through cat/cow and a feel-good chest stretch, then finish with calming box breathing in savasana. Perfect for stiff days, stress-y days, and “why are my shoulders up by my ears?” days.
5624.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000AShoulder Openers\u000ACat/Cow\u000ADown Dog\u000AGentle Cobra\u000AChild's Pose\u000AEagle Arms\u000ASeated Side Bends

5625.title: Whole Body Quick Yoga Flow
5625.theWhy: Open up tight hips, wake up your spine, and move through a gentle warrior flow designed to build strength through mobility. This practice blends cat-cow, supported sun-salute transitions, warrior poses, a wide-leg fold, and a supported squat to help release stiffness while lightly loading the legs and hips. You’ll finish on the floor with happy baby and a calming rest to let everything settle. A great choice for days when you feel creaky, tight, or like your hips and back need some extra attention.
5625.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000ANeck Mobility\u000ACat-Cow\u000ADownward Dog\u000ABaby Cobra\u000AChild's Pose\u000AWarrior I & II\u000AWide-Leg Forward Fold\u000AHappy Baby

5626.title: 20 Minute Sun Salutation
5626.theWhy: Take 20 minutes to reset your whole body with a slow, soothing sun salutation practice. You’ll move through gentle waves of standing stretches, forward folds, plank-to-cobra options, and downward dog-opening the shoulders, lengthening the calves and hamstrings, and easing tension from your neck and back. This is a perfect recovery-day flow when you want to feel looser, calmer, and a little more “ahhh” without turning it into a workout audition.
5626.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000ASun Salutation A\u000ASun Salutation B

5627.title: 20-30 Minute Ashtanga Practice
5627.theWhy: This one’s for the days you want yoga that feels a little more “workout” and a little less “nap.” You’ll move through a few rounds of Sun Salutations A + B, hit strong standing poses (hello legs), light up your core in boat pose, then finish with a little inversion play and a long exhale into rest. Breath leads, ego stays in the car.
5627.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000ASun Salutations A + B\u000AWarrior I\u000ATriangle\u000AExtended Side Angle\u000AWide-Leg Forward Fold\u000ABoat Pose\u000ASeated Forward Fold\u000AQuad Stretch\u000ABridge Pose\u000AShoulder Stand Prep

5628.title: Slow Flow
5628.theWhy: Need to calm your brain and unknot your body? This one is a two-for-one.\u000A\u000AWe start with a short, grounded breath practice, then flow through gentle mobility for your neck, shoulders, spine, hips, and hamstrings. There’s a sprinkle of strength (nothing scary-just enough to wake things up), and then we land in a real-deal Shavasana to let your nervous system exhale.\u000A\u000APerfect after a long day, a workout, or anytime you feel stiff, wired, and over it.
5628.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000ASeated Breathwork\u000ASeated Side Bends\u000ATabletop Cat/Cow\u000ADownward Dog\u000AWide-Knee Child's Pose\u000AHalf-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch

5629.title: 30 Minute Modified Sun Salutations and Standing Sequence
5629.theWhy: This is a stronger, steady-flow yoga practice that helps you build heat, improve posture, and calm your mind all at the same time. You’ll move through classic Sun Salutations, standing poses, and finishing stretches using smooth, rhythmic breathing to keep you grounded and focused. Expect strength, mobility, and that “I feel taller and looser” feeling when you’re done.
5629.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000ASun Salutation A\u000ASun Salutation B\u000APyramid\u000AStanding Balance Work\u000ASeated Fold

5631.title: 30 Min Bedtime Yin Yoga
5631.theWhy: This is your “put the phone down and let your body exhale” class. You’ll settle in with cozy props, hold a few yin shapes (think: hips + spine + deep calm), and finish with a don’t-mess-this-up Savasana that basically begs you to crawl straight into bed. No sweating. No performing. Just nervous-system gold.
5631.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000ASupported Child's Pose\u000ADownward Dog\u000ASleeping Pigeon\u000ASeated Forward Fold\u000AButterfly\u000ASupine Twist

5632.title: 20 Minute Ashtanga Practice
5632.theWhy: This is a classic, breath-led flow that moves through sun salutations, standing strength, seated stretching, and a strong finish. Expect down dog, lunges, twists, and some deeper shapes that feel so good when you’re ready for a full-body reset. Modify like a boss if you need to-step instead of jump, take breaks, and skip any inversion stuff if your head says “absolutely not today.”
5632.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000ASurya Namaskar A\u000ASurya Namaskar B\u000AStanding Sequence\u000ASeated Sequence\u000AInversion Work

5633.title: Yoga for Constipation
5633.theWhy: Bloated? Backed up? Feeling like your jeans are judging you for no reason?\u000A\u000AThis gentle flow helps get things moving using breath, twists, and hip openers that support your rest-and-digest nervous system. No crunches. No intensity. No pretending this is a workout. Just smart movement that eases belly pressure, releases tension through your back and hips, and helps your digestion do what it’s supposed to do.\u000A\u000APerfect for the days when you feel puffy, uncomfortable, or just “off”-especially after travel, stress, or a big meal.
5633.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000ABreathwork in Mountain Pose\u000AStanding Twists\u000AWide Leg Child's Pose\u000ALizard with Thoracic Rotation\u000ABaby Cobra\u000ASupine Twist

5635.title: Yoga for Better Sex
5635.theWhy: Leaking a little? Feeling tight? Wondering if you’re even doing Kegels right anymore?\u000A\u000AThis routine teaches your pelvic floor how to relax first, move well, and then gently turn back on-which is how it’s actually supposed to work. You’ll connect breath to your hips, ribs, and inner thighs so everything down there feels more comfortable, more responsive, and more in control.\u000A\u000ANo squeezing. No straining. No awkward guessing. Just smart movement that helps your body remember what to do.
5635.circuitsCopy: Poses in this flow: \u000A\u000ATabletop\u000AAdductor Rockbacks\u000ALizard\u000ASupported Deep Squat\u000ASeated Breathwork

5636.title: Nervous System Reset
5636.theWhy: Unwind tension and guide your body back to calm.\u000A\u000AWith gentle breathing and fully supported positions, this session helps shift you out of “go mode” and into true rest. Slow breaths and soft movement invite your nervous system to settle and your body to relax.\u000A\u000APerfect before bed, after a workout, or anytime you need a reset.\u000A\u000ALeave feeling lighter, quieter, and deeply at ease.
5636.circuitsCopy: Types of Breathwork in this flow: \u000A\u000ADiaphragmatic Breathing\u000ARelaxing Floor Breathing\u000ASide-lying Twist Breathing\u000AFolded/Prayer Breathing

5638.title: Pull It Together
5638.theWhy: Today’s workout is all about getting to know the moves and finding our baseline of strength for 2 sets of 12 reps. The moves? Squat, lunge, and pull focused. We’re also learning how to explode upward and land soft…all without leaving the ground this week! We’re creating the foundation on which we will spend the next 5 weeks building on.
5638.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000AUpward Explosion — 8 reps\u000ADownward Explosion — 8 reps\u000ABent Over Row — 12 reps\u000AWeighted Squats — 12 reps\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000ATripod Row — 12 reps left\u000ATripod Row — 12 reps right\u000ASplit Squats — 12 reps left\u000ASplit Squats — 12 reps right\u000ARest — 60 seconds

5639.title: Press Express
5639.theWhy: Another day of getting to know the exercises of the program. Today we’re focusing on hinging, thrusting, and pushing moves as well as learning to harness our power for future plyometric pushups! Yes, I said it! And no! Don’t be scared! We’re still finding what feels best for 12 reps, building that baseline!
5639.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000AExplosive Push Up — 8 reps\u000ARomanian Deadlift — 12 reps\u000ABench Press — 12 reps\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000AWeighted Hip Thrust — 12 reps\u000ASupported Seated Shoulder Press — 12 reps\u000ARest — 60 seconds

5640.title: HIIT Happens
5640.theWhy: This high intensity interval training workout is all about building your foundation! You’ll work hard for 30 seconds, then take a full 60 second rest to recover and come back strong. The focus today is on form, control, and setting the baseline. We’re learning what high intensity work really feels like and where we might be able to push a bit hard harder because as the weeks progress, we’ll be turning up the intensity!
5640.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A2 Sets\u000APogo Hops — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000A\u000A2 Sets (1 Set Each Side)\u000ASingle Arm Push Press — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000A\u000A2 Sets\u000AAlternating 1-Arm Squat Clean — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000A\u000A2 Sets (1 Set Each Side)\u000AStanding Knee Drive — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000A\u000A2 Sets\u000AAlternating Dumbbell Snatch — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 60 seconds

5642.title: Strong to the Core
5642.theWhy: This workout is all about building strength with offset or unilateral movements. We’re still finding our baseline of strength to build upon, focusing on clean form and mindful movement. These types of moves really help to even out strength and balances, so we can perform better in our future lifts. The fun part is, all of these moves really challenge the core!
5642.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000A1-Arm Weighted Squat — 12 reps right\u000A1-Arm Weighted Squat — 12 reps left\u000AKneeling 1-Arm Press — 12 reps right\u000AKneeling 1-Arm Press — 12 reps left\u000ARest — 60 Seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000ASingle Leg Deadlift — 12 reps right\u000ASingle Leg Deadlift — 12 reps left\u000ASupported Bent Over Row — 12 reps right\u000ASupported Bent Over Row — 12 reps left\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000A\u000ACore Finisher\u000A\u000ASide Plank Dumbbell Press — 12 reps left\u000ASide Plank Dumbbell Press — 12 reps right

5643.title: Rowin' With The Homies
5643.theWhy: This week, we’re progressing by slowing the tempo of the reps and focusing on clean form and muscular failure, not just “the burn”. You don’t have to actually “fail” on the exercises, but you want to build the awareness around being close to it! The moves remain the same: squat, lunge, and pull-focused exercises. We’re continuing to learn how to explode upward and land softly, and maybe finding courage to leave the ground!
5643.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000AUpward Explosion — 8 reps\u000ABent Over Row — 10 reps\u000AWeighted Squats — 10 reps\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000ATripod Row — 10 reps left\u000ATripod Row — 10 reps right\u000ASplit Squats — 10 reps left\u000ASplit Squats — 10 reps right\u000ARest — 60 seconds

5644.title: Thrust Issues
5644.theWhy: Today we’re focusing again on hinging, thrusting, and pushing moves as well as building the foundation for plyometric pushups. We are dropping reps from 12 to 10 and finding where muscular failure fits in. We’re focusing on form, tempo, and control for quality reps and maximal strength gains! This is the last week we’ll be performing two legged hip thrusts, as I expect us to max out on available dumbbells. Bring on the single leg version!
5644.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000AExplosive Push Up — 8 reps\u000ARomanian Deadlift — 10 reps\u000ABench Press — 10 reps\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000AWeighted Hip Thrust — 10 reps\u000ASupported Seated Shoulder Press — 10 reps\u000ARest — 60 seconds

5649.title: HIIT Me Baby One More Time
5649.theWhy: This week’s high intensity interval training workout is about pushing harder than before! Timer is the same as last week, but expect a different timing structure in the weeks to come. You’ll work hard for 30 seconds, then take a full 60 second rest to recover and come back strong. The focus today is on form, control, and trying the harder version of last weeks exercises. We’re still learning what high intensity work really feels like.
5649.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000APogo Hops — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000APush Press — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000AAlternating 1-Arm Squat Clean — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000AExplosive High Knee Drive Switch — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000AAlternating Dumbbell Snatch — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 60 seconds

5650.title: The Midsection Connection
5650.theWhy: This is our offset/unilateral style strength day, all moves that secretly challenge the core! The only thing that changes this week is we’re dropping the reps from 12 to 10. So, just like in our other workouts, we’re focusing on finding failure in this range. Slowing the tempo a bit, being mindful of form and technique before adding more weight. Let’s have fun with this one!
5650.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000A1-Arm Weighted Squat — 10 reps left\u000A1-Arm Weighted Squat — 10 reps right\u000AKneeling 1-Arm Press — 10 reps left\u000AKneeling 1-Arm Press — 10 reps right\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000ASingle Leg Deadlift — 10 reps left\u000ASingle Leg Deadlift — 10 reps right\u000A1-Arm Bent Over Row — 10 reps left\u000A1-Arm Bent Over Row — 10 reps right\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000A\u000ACore Finisher\u000A\u000ASide Plank Dumbbell Press — 10 reps left\u000ASide Plank Dumbbell Press — 10 reps right

5651.title: Pull House
5651.theWhy: This week’s all about finding your edge! Today’s range is anywhere between 8 and 10 reps, which means we can add some weight to those moves that felt really good last couple weeks. Our second circuit of exercises is intensifying! We’re opting for a harder version of the row and split squat. We’re also adding depth to our plyometric work, so be ready for it!
5651.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000ASit to Explode — 5 reps\u000ASit to Jump — 5 reps\u000ABent Over Row — 8 reps\u000AWeighted Squats — 8 reps\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000ABent Over Wide Row — 10 reps\u000ABulgarian Split Squats — 10 reps right\u000ABulgarian Split Squats — 10 reps left\u000ARest — 60 seconds

5652.title: P-Push It Real Good
5652.theWhy: Ready to progress again?! We’re making SERIOUS strength gains today by dropping the reps, and upping the weights on the moves we’re feeling most confident in. But, fair warning, our two legged hip thrust has now become a single leg and it is a BURNER! Fear not, your glutes will thank me!
5652.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000AExplosive Push Up — 8 reps\u000ARomanian Deadlift — 8 reps\u000ABench Press — 8 reps\u000ARest — 60 seconds\u000A\u000ACircuit 2\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000ASingle Leg Hip Thrust — 10 reps\u000ASupported Seated Shoulder Press — 8 reps\u000ARest — 60 seconds

5653.title: HIIT Me With Your Best Shot
5653.theWhy: Are you ready to really find your edge?? We’ve dropped our rest time in between the exercises, and added it at the end of each circuit. We are also upping the intensity of a couple moves today. So be ready to huff and puff and really welcome that true high intensity into your life. This one is UNDER 20 min today! Knowing that the workout is shorter might give you the confidence to push harder during your working interval sets. Let’s do this!
5653.circuitsCopy: Circuit 1\u000A\u000A2 Rounds\u000APogo Hops — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000AThruster — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000ADouble Squat Clean — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000AHigh Knee Pause — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 30 seconds\u000AAlternating Dumbbell Snatch — 30 seconds\u000ARest — 2 minutes

5654.title: Saved By The Core
5654.theWhy: This is our offset/unilateral strength day, where we’ll challenge our core with all the moves! We will be playing with variations and tempo changes of the exercises we’ve gotten to know over the past couple weeks.

5744.title: Hip Stretches
5744.theWhy: Tight hips? Stiff inner thighs? This gentle, breath-led routine targets the exact areas that commonly lose mobility in midlife-glutes, groin, and deep hip muscles that affect how you walk, squat, and move every day.\u000A\u000AYou’ll work through slow 90/90 stretches, supported lunges, and inner thigh mobility to restore range of motion without stressing your joints. An optional weight adds intensity if you want it, but this flow is effective with just your body.\u000A\u000APerfect before a workout, after a long day, or anytime your hips need a reset.

5746.title: Glute Release
5746.theWhy: If your butt feels tight, your hips feel glued shut, or your low back is doing that “I’m fine… actually I’m not” thing-this one’s for you.\u000A\u000AThis is a glute release routine that hits the deep stuff: pigeon pose, figure-four stretches, gentle twists, and (chef’s kiss) a sciatic nerve floss to help when the issue is more nerve tension than “just stretch harder.” Everything is done slow, breath-led, and with built-in options so you can keep it in a feel-good range.\u000A\u000ADo this after sitting, before a workout, or anytime you want your glutes to stop auditioning for “Most Dramatic Muscle Group.”

5754.title: Shoulders, Back, and Rib Mobility
5754.theWhy: This upper-body mobility flow is all about giving your shoulders, chest, and upper back the attention they desperately deserve. Using a resistance band for feedback, you’ll work through gentle cat-cow movements, thoracic rotation, and side reaches that help your shoulder blades move better and your ribs open up. This is especially helpful if you sit a lot, lift weights, or notice tension creeping into your neck and low back.\u000A\u000AThe goal here isn’t stretching for the sake of stretching-it’s helping your upper back and ribs move so your low back doesn’t have to do all the work. Expect to feel more open through your chest, less tight through your lats, and a little taller when you’re done.

5755.title: Upper Chest & Back Mobility
5755.theWhy: This is your “fix my desk posture” mini reset. We’ll loosen up the spine with cat-cow, melt into a bench-supported puppy pose to open the shoulders, then hit wall slides to stack ribs over hips (no dramatic back arching allowed). Finish with band openers to un-hunch your chest and help you stand taller-like you didn’t just answer 47 emails.

5756.title: Light Upper Body with Focused Lower Body Flow

You’ll start with a seated glute twist, move to a wall hamstring stretch (the good kind that makes you exhale), and finish with a tucked-pelvis lunge to open the front of the hips-especially helpful if you sit a lot or have C-section scar tightness. Slow, simple, and very effective.

5758.title: Hip Openers

You’ll move through 90/90 hip stretches, a properly-done hip flexor stretch (with that little pelvic tuck), side-body/low-back release for the QL, and finish with a happy baby hang. Expect lots of breathing, lots of “oof,” and a big dose of relief.

5759.title: Hip Flexor Release
5759.theWhy: This is a laser-focused hip flexor release session-the kind that feels small but works deep. You’ll use a gentle pelvic tuck, slow pulses, a quad + hip flexor combo, and a supported supine stretch to finally get into those tight front-of-the-hip muscles that love to tug on your low back. We finish in child’s pose to let your breath calm everything down.

5760.title: Upper Back and Thoracic Spine Mobility
5760.theWhy: If your upper back feels stiff, rounded, or “stuck,” this one is going to feel like a deep sigh for your spine.\u000A\u000AUsing just a chair, we’ll gently open the thoracic spine, stretch the lats and inner thighs, and finish with calming breathwork that helps your pelvic floor fully relax. This is the kind of mobility work that improves posture, eases neck and shoulder tension, and helps you move and breathe better in your strength workouts.\u000A\u000ASlow. Simple. Powerful.

5766.title: Neck and Upper Back Openers

You’ll gently release tension through the neck and upper traps, open up the mid-back with a simple twist, and finish with a relaxing hip and pelvic floor stretch. It’s simple, effective, and a great reset for the upper body. Take a few deep breaths and let some of that built-up tension go.

You’ll open the back, loosen the hips, stretch the quads and hamstrings, and finish with a deep squat to bring it all together. It’s simple, energizing, and a great way to start your day feeling more mobile and ready to move.

5769.title: Hips & Core
5769.theWhy: A feel-good combo of core work + hip mobility. You’ll wake up the hips, fire up the deep abs, and move through flows that build stability and balance. Expect to feel more connected through your core and a lot looser through the hips.

5770.title: Cesarean Mobility

It’s a beautiful warm-up before your workout or a calming cooldown after.

The emphasis here is on breathing, softening, and allowing the pelvic floor and hips to let go. This is a calming, feel-good session designed to improve hip mobility, reduce inner-thigh stiffness, and help your body shift into recovery mode.

5774.theWhy: If your bladder is acting like it’s training for a marathon, this is your reset. Calming breaths + hip and rib mobility to help your pelvic floor stop gripping and start relaxing.
